--- FILE: ChunkProject.ps1 ---
```powershell
﻿$SourceDir = "D:\Automation\000-Open BIM Studio\00-OpenBIMStudio"
$OutputDir = "D:\Automation\000-Open BIM Studio\00-OpenBIMStudio\OpenBIMStudio_Parts"
$MaxCharsPerPart = 250000 # Increased to minimize parts (~60k tokens)

if (!(Test-Path $OutputDir)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $OutputDir | Out-Null }

# 1. Exclude heavy folders AND binary/non-code file extensions
$ExcludeFolders = @('node_modules', 'dist', '.git')
$ExcludeFiles = @('*.png', '*.jpg', '*.jpeg', '*.gif', '*.svg', '*.ico', '*.woff', '*.woff2', '*.ttf', '*.eot', '*.mp4', '*.pdf', '*.zip', '*.lock', 'package-lock.json', 'yarn.lock', 'pnpm-lock.yaml')

$Files = Get-ChildItem -Path $SourceDir -Recurse -File | Where-Object { 
    $path = $_.FullName
    $isExcludedFolder = $ExcludeFolders | Where-Object { $path -match $_ }
    $isExcludedFile = $ExcludeFiles | Where-Object { $path -like $_ }
    -not $isExcludedFolder -and -not $isExcludedFile
}

$PartNumber = 1
$CurrentChars = 0
$CurrentContent = ""

foreach ($File in $Files) {
    $RelativePath = $File.FullName.Replace($SourceDir, "")
    # Read file as raw text
    $FileContent = Get-Content $File.FullName -Raw -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    
    if ($null -eq $FileContent -or $FileContent.Length -eq 0) { continue } 

    $Block = "`n--- FILE: $RelativePath ---`n$FileContent`n--- END FILE ---`n"
    $BlockLength = $Block.Length

    if (($CurrentChars + $BlockLength) -gt $MaxCharsPerPart) {
        $OutFile = Join-Path $OutputDir "Project_Part_$PartNumber.txt"
        $CurrentContent | Out-File -FilePath $OutFile -Encoding utf8
        Write-Host "Created $OutFile"
        $PartNumber++
        $CurrentChars = 0
        $CurrentContent = ""
    }

    $CurrentContent += $Block
    $CurrentChars += $BlockLength
}

if ($CurrentChars -gt 0) {
    $OutFile = Join-Path $OutputDir "Project_Part_$PartNumber.txt"
    $CurrentContent | Out-File -FilePath $OutFile -Encoding utf8
    Write-Host "Created $OutFile"
}

Write-Host "Success! Minimized into $PartNumber parts."
```
--- END FILE ---

--- FILE: Collect-And-Push.ps1 ---
```powershell
<#
.SYNOPSIS
  Bundle an entire project (structure + source) into a few large files and push to GitHub.
#>

[CmdletBinding()]
param(
    [string]$OutputDir      = ".\_export",
    [int]   $MaxBundleMB    = 8,
    [switch]$Push,
    [string]$Branch         = "main",
    [string]$CommitMessage  = ""
)

$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"
$ProgressPreference    = "SilentlyContinue"

# ---------- Config ----------
$Root = (Get-Location).Path

$SkipDirs = @(
    ".git", "node_modules", "dist", "build", "out", ".next", ".nuxt",
    ".cache", ".parcel-cache", "coverage", ".vscode", ".idea",
    "bin", "obj", ".vs", ".turbo", ".vercel", ".netlify",
    "vendor", "Pods", ".gradle", ".mvn", "__pycache__", ".pytest_cache",
    ".mypy_cache", "target", ".terraform", "_export"
)

$SourceExt = @(
    ".ts", ".tsx", ".js", ".jsx", ".mjs", ".cjs",
    ".json", ".jsonc", ".json5",
    ".css", ".scss", ".sass", ".less",
    ".html", ".htm", ".vue", ".svelte", ".astro",
    ".md", ".mdx", ".txt", ".yml", ".yaml", ".toml", ".ini", ".cfg",
    ".py", ".cs", ".cpp", ".cc", ".cxx", ".h", ".hpp",
    ".java", ".kt", ".kts", ".go", ".rs", ".rb", ".php",
    ".sh", ".ps1", ".psm1", ".psd1", ".bat", ".cmd",
    ".sql", ".graphql", ".gql", ".proto",
    ".svg", ".xml", ".plist", ".gradle", ".properties"
)

$AlwaysIncludeNames = @(
    "Dockerfile", "Makefile", "LICENSE", "README", "CHANGELOG",
    ".gitignore", ".gitattributes", ".editorconfig", ".npmrc",
    ".prettierrc", ".eslintrc", "Procfile"
)

# ---------- Helpers ----------
function Test-SkipPath {
    param([string]$FullPath)
    $rel = $FullPath.Substring($Root.Length).TrimStart('\','/')
    $parts = $rel -split '[\\/]'
    foreach ($p in $parts) {
        if ($SkipDirs -contains $p) { return $true }
    }
    return $false
}

function Get-RelPath {
    param([string]$FullPath)
    return $FullPath.Substring($Root.Length).TrimStart('\','/').Replace('\','/')
}

function Write-Utf8NoBom {
    param([string]$Path, [string]$Content)
    $enc = New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)
    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($Path, $Content, $enc)
}

# ---------- Prep ----------
if (Test-Path $OutputDir) {
    Remove-Item $OutputDir -Recurse -Force
}
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $OutputDir | Out-Null

$manifest = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[object]
$treeLines = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]

Write-Host "Scanning $Root ..." -ForegroundColor Cyan

# ---------- Collect files ----------
$allFiles = Get-ChildItem -Path $Root -Recurse -File -Force |
    Where-Object { -not (Test-SkipPath $_.FullName) }

$sourceFiles = @()
foreach ($f in $allFiles) {
    $ext = $f.Extension.ToLowerInvariant()
    $isSource = ($SourceExt -contains $ext) -or
                ($AlwaysIncludeNames -contains $f.Name) -or
                ($f.Name -like ".env*")
    if ($isSource) { $sourceFiles += $f }
}

$sourceFiles = $sourceFiles | Sort-Object FullName

Write-Host ("Found {0} files total; {1} source files." -f $allFiles.Count, $sourceFiles.Count) -ForegroundColor Green

# ---------- Build tree (ASCII-only) ----------
function Add-Tree {
    param([string]$Path, [string]$Prefix = "")
    $items = Get-ChildItem -Path $Path -Force |
        Sort-Object @{E={$_.PSIsContainer};Descending=$true}, Name
    for ($i = 0; $i -lt $items.Count; $i++) {
        $item = $items[$i]
        if (Test-SkipPath $item.FullName) { continue }
        $isLast = ($i -eq $items.Count - 1)
        if ($isLast) { $branch = "\-- " } else { $branch = "|-- " }
        $treeLines.Add("$Prefix$branch$($item.Name)")
        if ($item.PSIsContainer) {
            if ($isLast) { $newPrefix = $Prefix + "    " }
            else         { $newPrefix = $Prefix + "|   " }
            Add-Tree -Path $item.FullName -Prefix $newPrefix
        }
    }
}

$treeLines.Add((Split-Path $Root -Leaf) + "/")
Add-Tree -Path $Root

Write-Utf8NoBom -Path (Join-Path $OutputDir "structure.txt") -Content ($treeLines -join "`n")
Write-Host "Wrote structure.txt" -ForegroundColor Yellow

# ---------- Bundle source ----------
$maxBytes = $MaxBundleMB * 1MB
$bundleIndex = 0
$bundleBuffer = New-Object System.Text.StringBuilder
$bundleBytes = 0
$currentFiles = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]

function Flush-Bundle {
    if ($bundleBuffer.Length -eq 0) { return }
    $script:bundleIndex++
    $name = "bundle-{0:D3}.md" -f $script:bundleIndex
    $path = Join-Path $OutputDir $name
    $header = "# Bundle $($script:bundleIndex) - $($currentFiles.Count) files`n`n"
    Write-Utf8NoBom -Path $path -Content ($header + $bundleBuffer.ToString())
    Write-Host ("  wrote {0} ({1:N2} MB, {2} files)" -f $name, ($bundleBytes/1MB), $currentFiles.Count) -ForegroundColor DarkGray
    $script:bundleBuffer = New-Object System.Text.StringBuilder
    $script:bundleBytes = 0
    $script:currentFiles = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
}

$globalFileIndex = 0
foreach ($f in $sourceFiles) {
    $rel = Get-RelPath $f.FullName

    try {
        $bytes = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($f.FullName)
    } catch {
        Write-Warning "Skip (unreadable): $rel"
        continue
    }

    $isBinary = $false
    $checkLen = [Math]::Min(8192, $bytes.Length)
    for ($i = 0; $i -lt $checkLen; $i++) {
        if ($bytes[$i] -eq 0) { $isBinary = $true; break }
    }
    if ($isBinary) {
        Write-Host "  skip binary: $rel" -ForegroundColor DarkYellow
        continue
    }

    $text = [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetString($bytes)

    $ext = $f.Extension.TrimStart('.').ToLowerInvariant()
    $lang = switch ($ext) {
        "ts"   { "ts" }   "tsx"  { "tsx" }  "js"   { "js" }
        "jsx"  { "jsx" }  "mjs"  { "js" }   "cjs"  { "js" }
        "json" { "json" } "jsonc"{ "jsonc" } "json5"{ "json5" }
        "css"  { "css" }  "scss" { "scss" } "less" { "less" }
        "html" { "html" } "md"   { "md" }   "yml"  { "yaml" }
        "yaml" { "yaml" } "toml" { "toml" } "py"   { "py" }
        "cs"   { "csharp" } "cpp" { "cpp" } "h"    { "cpp" }
        "hpp"  { "cpp" }  "java" { "java" } "kt"   { "kotlin" }
        "go"   { "go" }   "rs"   { "rust" } "rb"   { "ruby" }
        "php"  { "php" }  "sh"   { "sh" }   "ps1"  { "powershell" }
        "sql"  { "sql" }  "xml"  { "xml" }  "svg"  { "xml" }
        "gradle" { "groovy" } "properties" { "properties" }
        default { "" }
    }

    $sha = (Get-FileHash -Path $f.FullName -Algorithm SHA256).Hash
    $manifest.Add([pscustomobject]@{
        index    = $globalFileIndex++
        path     = $rel
        size     = $f.Length
        sha256   = $sha
        lang     = $lang
    }) | Out-Null

    $entry = "`n--- FILE: $rel ---`n" + '```' + "$lang`n$text`n" + '```' + "`n--- END FILE ---`n"
    $entryBytes = [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetByteCount($entry)

    if ($bundleBytes + $entryBytes -gt $maxBytes -and $bundleBuffer.Length -gt 0) {
        Flush-Bundle
    }

    [void]$bundleBuffer.Append($entry)
    $bundleBytes += $entryBytes
    $currentFiles.Add($rel) | Out-Null
}
Flush-Bundle

# ---------- Manifest ----------
$manifestObj = [pscustomobject]@{
    project    = (Split-Path $Root -Leaf)
    generated  = (Get-Date).ToString("o")
    root       = $Root
    totalFiles = $manifest.Count
    bundles    = $bundleIndex
    files      = $manifest
}
$json = $manifestObj | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 6
Write-Utf8NoBom -Path (Join-Path $OutputDir "manifest.json") -Content $json
Write-Host "Wrote manifest.json" -ForegroundColor Yellow

# ---------- .gitattributes ----------
$gitAttr = @"
* text=auto eol=lf
*.ps1 text eol=crlf
*.bat text eol=crlf
*.cmd text eol=crlf
*.md text eol=lf
"@
Write-Utf8NoBom -Path (Join-Path $OutputDir ".gitattributes") -Content $gitAttr

# ---------- README ----------
$readmeLines = @(
    "# OpenBIMStudio - Code Export",
    "",
    "Generated: $($manifestObj.generated)",
    "",
    "- structure.txt - full folder tree",
    "- manifest.json - every file: path, size, sha256, language",
    "- bundle-XXX.md - full source code, grouped to stay under GitHub preview limits",
    "",
    "Total files bundled: $($manifest.Count)",
    "Total bundles: $bundleIndex",
    "",
    "Each file inside a bundle is delimited by:",
    "",
    "    --- FILE: <relative/path> ---",
    '    ```<lang>',
    "    ...content...",
    '    ```',
    "    --- END FILE ---"
)
Write-Utf8NoBom -Path (Join-Path $OutputDir "README.md") -Content ($readmeLines -join "`n")

# ---------- Push ----------
if ($Push) {
    Write-Host "`n=== Pushing to GitHub ===" -ForegroundColor Cyan

    $git = Get-Command git -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    if (-not $git) { throw "git not found in PATH." }

    if (-not (Test-Path (Join-Path $Root ".git"))) {
        Write-Host "No .git found - initializing..." -ForegroundColor Yellow
        git init | Out-Host
        git branch -M $Branch | Out-Host
    }

    $remotes = git remote
    if ($remotes -notcontains "origin") {
        $url = Read-Host "No 'origin' remote. Enter GitHub URL (https://github.com/user/repo.git)"
        git remote add origin $url | Out-Host
    }

    if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($CommitMessage)) {
        $CommitMessage = "chore: add full code export ($($manifest.Count) files, $bundleIndex bundles)"
    }

    git add $OutputDir | Out-Host
    git status --short | Out-Host
    git commit -m $CommitMessage | Out-Host
    git push -u origin $Branch | Out-Host

    Write-Host "Pushed." -ForegroundColor Green
}

Write-Host "`nDone. Output: $OutputDir" -ForegroundColor Green
Write-Host "Next: open https://github.com/<you>/<repo>/tree/$Branch/$((Split-Path $OutputDir -Leaf))" -ForegroundColor Green
```
--- END FILE ---

--- FILE: docs/CAD_GAPS_CLOSURE.md ---
```md
# CAD Gaps Closed

## Install

```bash
cp -r artifacts/src/* <OpenBIMStudio>/src/
npm run typecheck && npm run dev
```

## Full CAD tool matrix

| Tool | Keys | Notes |
|------|------|-------|
| Line | **L** | Two clicks |
| Polyline | **PL** | Multi-click, **Enter** finishes |
| Rectangle | **REC** | Corner–corner |
| Circle | **CC** | Center–radius |
| Arc | **A** | Center–sweep |
| Text | **DT** | Prompt for string |
| Offset | **O** | Offset last entity |
| **Trim** | **TR** | Cutting edge → object |
| **Extend** | **EX** | Boundary → object |
| **Fillet** | **FI** | Two lines + radius (**Fillet R**) |
| Erase | **E** | Click entity or last |
| Copy | **CO** | Delta X/Y prompt |
| Mirror | **MI** | Vertical axis at click |
| Distance | **DI** | Two points → px |
| Undo | **U** | |
| Ortho | **F8** | |
| Grid | **F7** | |
| Layers | panel | Click to activate |

## UI

| Entry | |
|-------|--|
| Yellow **CAD** button | bottom-left |
| **Ctrl+Shift+D** | CAD panel |
| Command Center → **CAD / Drafting** | |
| Gold **command line** bar | bottom center during tools |

## Workflow examples

**Trim**
1. TR → click cutting line → click segment to shorten  

**Extend**
1. EX → click boundary → click segment end to lengthen  

**Fillet**
1. Set radius with **Fillet R** → FI → click two lines  

**Layers**
1. CAD panel → Layers row → click layer name to make active  

## Runtime API

```js
__obsCad.engine.trimAt(cutterPt, targetPt)
__obsCad.engine.extendTo(boundaryPt, targetPt)
__obsCad.engine.filletAt(pt1, pt2, radius)
__obsCad.engine.distance(a, b)
__obsCad.engine.pickEntity(pt)
__obsCad.engine.listLayers()
```

## Still optional later

- Chamfer  
- Hatch fill patterns  
- Block / XREF library  
- Full typed command-line parser (`LINE 0,0 100,0`)

```
--- END FILE ---

# Open BIM Studio ↔ Revit — Critical Gaps Closed

## Install

```bash
cp -r artifacts/src/* <OpenBIMStudio>/src/
cd <OpenBIMStudio>
npm run typecheck
npm run dev
```

`main.ts` already contains `import "./critical-gaps-boot"` — no entry-point change.

--- FILE: docs/DRAWINGS_DWG_ENGINE.md ---
```md
# Drawings · DXF / DWG Engine

## Install

```bash
cp -r artifacts/src/* <OpenBIMStudio>/src/
npm run typecheck && npm run dev
```

### Optional native DWG (browser WASM)

```bash
npm i @mlightcad/libredwg-web
```

Without it, **DXF** still works fully; for DWG convert to DXF first (any CAD).

## What you get

| Capability | Format | Status |
|------------|--------|--------|
| Import drawing | **DXF** | ✅ pure TypeScript parser |
| Import drawing | **DWG** | ✅ if `@mlightcad/libredwg-web` installed |
| Export CAD sketch | **DXF** | ✅ R2010 ASCII |
| Load into CAD overlay | DXF/DWG | ✅ lines, circles, arcs, polylines, text |
| Load into 3D scene | DXF/DWG | ✅ THREE.Line preview |
| Layers | DXF | ✅ read + write |

## UI

| Entry | |
|-------|--|
| Purple **DWG** button | bottom-left (next to CAD / RC) |
| **Ctrl+Shift+G** | Drawings panel |
| CAD panel → **Import DXF / Export DXF** | |
| Command Center → **Drawings DXF / Export DXF** | |
| Ctrl+P → “Import DXF / DWG” | |

## Modules

```
src/modules/drawings/dxf-types.ts
src/modules/drawings/dxf-reader.ts
src/modules/drawings/dxf-writer.ts
src/modules/drawings/dwg-engine.ts
src/features/drawings-panel.ts
```

## API

```js
// Import
await __obsDrawings.importDrawingFile(file)

// Export current CAD entities
__obsDrawings.exportCadAsDxf("my-plan.dxf")

// Parse / write raw
const doc = __obsDrawings.parseDxf(dxfText)
const text = __obsDrawings.writeDxf(doc)

// Push to CAD or 3D only
__obsDrawings.loadDxfIntoCad(doc)
__obsDrawings.loadDxfIntoScene(doc, { scale: 0.001 })
```

## CAD gaps (complete set)

Draw · PLine · Rect · Circle · Arc · Text · Offset · **Trim · Extend · Fillet** · Erase · Copy · Mirror · Dist · Ortho · Grid · Layers · **DXF/DWG I/O**

## Note on DWG

DWG is a proprietary binary format. Full support in-browser needs LibreDWG WASM (`@mlightcad/libredwg-web`, GPL).  
OpenBIMStudio ships a complete **DXF** engine with zero extra deps so drawings always work offline.

```
--- END FILE ---

--- FILE: docs/INSTALL_AND_UX.md ---
```md
# Open BIM Studio — Revit Parity Package

## Install (one step)

```bash
# From your OpenBIMStudio project root
cp -r path/to/artifacts/src/* src/
# or unzip:
# unzip OpenBIMStudio-Revit-Parity.zip -d /tmp/parity && cp -r /tmp/parity/src/* src/

npm run typecheck
npm run dev
```

`main.ts` already has `import "./critical-gaps-boot"` — no entry change.

---

## Error-safe design

| Rule | How |
|------|-----|
| Boot never hard-crashes | Every module uses `import()` inside `safe()` |
| One bad module | Logged as `[critical-gaps-boot] <name>` — rest still load |
| Notifications | Correct API: `notify(kind, message, { timeout })` |
| Missing scene | Geometry place buttons toast “Scene not ready” instead of throwing |

Console success line:

```
[critical-gaps-boot] all critical gaps wired
```

---

## Clear UI — where every function lives

### 1. Revit Command Center (primary)

Opens automatically once per session so you see the full tool map.

| Open | |
|------|--|
| Blue **RC** button | bottom-left |
| **⌘ Command Center** | bottom toolbar |
| **Ctrl+Shift+R** | keyboard |
| **Ctrl+P** → “Revit Command Center” | palette |

**Sections inside the panel**

| Section | Functions |
|---------|-----------|
| Architecture | Straight / L / U Stair · Railing · Curtain Wall · Create Room |
| Modify | Align X · Align Z · Distribute · Match Props · Paint · Group · Create Similar |
| View | Hide · Isolate · Reset Vis · Work Plane XY/XZ · 2D Draft |
| Project panels | Rooms · Phases · Design Options · Groups · Copy/Monitor · Solve Hosts |

Greyed buttons = module still loading. Re-open the panel after ~1s.

### 2. Bottom toolbar

Quick bar: Command Center · Draft · Hosts · Solve · generators · Align · Match · visibility · Phases / Rooms / Options.

### 3. Dockable panels

Rooms & Areas · Phasing · Design Options · Model Groups · Copy/Monitor  
(draggable, close with ✕)

### 4. Command palette (Ctrl+P)

Search: `Stair`, `Align`, `Match`, `Phase`, `Room`, `Hide`, `Curtain`, `Group`, `Work Plane`.

---

## Smoke test (2 minutes)

1. App loads → Command Center opens (or click **RC**).
2. Status line lists ready modules.
3. **Straight Stair** → mesh + success toast.
4. **Create Room** → room number + area toast.
5. **Phasing** → panel opens; change filter.
6. Select 2+ elements → **Align X**.
7. **Ctrl+P** → type `Match Properties`.

---

## Capability matrix

| Revit workflow | Status |
|----------------|--------|
| Parametric families / formulas / constraints | ✅ |
| Nested families / arrays | ✅ |
| Type catalogs | ✅ |
| Shared parameters | ✅ |
| Rooms & areas | ✅ |
| Phasing + filters | ✅ |
| Design options | ✅ |
| Model groups | ✅ |
| Reference planes | ✅ |
| Stairs / railings / curtain walls | ✅ |
| Align / distribute / match props | ✅ |
| Temp dimensions / hide / isolate | ✅ |
| Copy / Monitor | ✅ |
| MEP browser / nav bar / fab / P&ID | ✅ enabled |

Deferred (not blocking): native `.rfa` import, adaptive sketch editor UI, granular worksharing locks.

```md
# Parametric Engine — Revit-competitive layer for Open BIM Studio

## What you already had

| Module | Role |
|--------|------|
| `types.ts` | `FamilyDefinition`, parameters, type/instance scope, basic geometry specs |
| `formula-engine.ts` | Topo-sorted formulas, cycle detection, Math helpers |
| `parametric-geometry.ts` | box / cylinder / extrusion / composed / custom |
| `registry.ts` + `store.ts` | CRUD, resolveParams, buildGeometry |
| `builtin-families.ts` | Seed walls, doors, windows, MEP, … |

## What this package adds

| File | Capability |
|------|------------|
| **`parametric-engine.ts`** | Full pipeline: shared → type → instance → formulas → **constraints** → geometry (sweep / revolve / loft / void / conditional / nested / array) |
| **`formula-engine-enhanced.ts`** | `if()`, boolean ops, comparisons, unit helpers (`mm`, `ft`, `deg`), dependency graph |
| **`constraint-graph.ts`** | equality, offset, ratio, sum, difference, fixed, distance |
| **`array-expander.ts`** | Linear / rotational / grouped arrays with alternate mirror |
| **`nested-families.ts`** | Nested family refs + param mapping + shared flag |
| **`types-extended.ts`** | TypeScript types for the new geometry kinds |
| **`registry-parametric.ts`** | Drop-in `createParametricFamilyService()` |

## Integration (minimal)

### 1. Prefer the enhanced formula engine

In `registry.ts` (or anywhere that imports `evaluateParameters`):

```ts
// was:
import { evaluateParameters } from "./formula-engine";
// become:
import { evaluateParameters } from "./formula-engine-enhanced";
```

Or rename: copy `formula-engine-enhanced.ts` over `formula-engine.ts`.

### 2. Switch the service factory

In `src/modules/families/index.ts`:

```ts
// was:
import { createFamilyService } from "./registry";
// become:
import { createParametricFamilyService as createFamilyService } from "./registry-parametric";
```

`setupFamilies()` and `ctx.features.family` stay the same shape; you gain:

```ts
const fam = ctx.features.family as ParametricFamilyService;

fam.buildParametric(familyId, typeId, { overrides: { Width: 1.2 } });
fam.setConstraints(familyId, [
  { kind: "ratio", a: "Height", b: "Width", k: 2.1 },
  { kind: "offset", a: "HeadHeight", b: "Height", delta: 0.05 },
]);
fam.reportingValues(familyId, typeId);
```

### 3. Author advanced geometry in family definitions

```ts
const door: FamilyDefinition = {
  // …id, name, category, ifcEntity, parameters…
  geometry: {
    kind: "composed",
    parts: [
      {
        kind: "extrusion",
        profile: { kind: "rect", w: { ref: "Width" }, h: { ref: "Height" } },
        depth: { ref: "Thickness" },
      },
      {
        kind: "conditional",
        when: "HasPanel",
        then: {
          kind: "box",
          w: { ref: "PanelWidth" },
          d: { ref: "PanelDepth" },
          h: { ref: "PanelHeight" },
          transform: { translate: [{ const: 0 }, { const: 0 }, { ref: "PanelOffset" }] },
        },
      },
      {
        kind: "array",
        count: { ref: "MullionCount" },
        step: [{ ref: "MullionSpacing" }, { const: 0 }, { const: 0 }],
        of: {
          kind: "box",
          w: { const: 0.05 },
          d: { ref: "Thickness" },
          h: { ref: "Height" },
        },
      },
    ],
  },
  // …
};
```

### 4. Wire type-edit propagation in authoring

When the user edits a **type** parameter in the property palette:

```ts
const bindings: InstanceParamBinding[] = elements
  .filter(e => e.familyId === familyId && e.familyTypeId === typeId)
  .map(e => ({
    elementId: e.id,
    familyId: e.familyId!,
    typeId: e.familyTypeId ?? null,
    overrides: e.instanceParams ?? {},
  }));

const updated = fam.propagateType(familyId, typeId, bindings);
for (const [elementId, params] of updated) {
  authoring.updateElementParams(elementId, params);
  authoring.rebuildElement(elementId);
}
```

## Parameter evaluation order (matches Revit intent)

1. Family defaults  
2. Shared / project parameters (optional)  
3. Type values  
4. Instance overrides  
5. Min/max/integer clamp  
6. Formula pass (topo-sorted)  
7. Constraint solve  
8. Final clamp  

## Formula quick reference

```
= Width * 2
= if(IsDouble, Width / 2, Width)
= max(Height, 2.1)
= HeadHeight - Height          // reporting
= mm(50)                      // 0.05 m
= sind(30) * Radius
= and(HasFrame, gt(Width, 0.9))
```

## Constraints quick reference

```ts
{ kind: "equality", a: "A", b: "B" }
{ kind: "offset", a: "Top", b: "Bottom", delta: 3.0 }
{ kind: "ratio", a: "H", b: "W", k: 1.618 }
{ kind: "sum", a: "Total", terms: ["A", "B", "C"] }
{ kind: "fixed", a: "Clearance", value: 0.15 }
{ kind: "distance", a: "X2", b: "X1", distance: 1.2, drive: "a" }
```

## Gaps vs full Revit (honest roadmap)

| Revit feature | Status here |
|---------------|-------------|
| Type / instance parameters + formulas | ✅ |
| Nested families + param map | ✅ |
| Arrays | ✅ |
| Sweeps / revolves | ✅ (profile-based) |
| Voids (boolean cut) | ⚠️ marked; CSG subtraction still approximate |
| Reference planes / dims in sketch | ❌ UI not yet |
| Adaptive components / points | ❌ |
| Full NURBS loft | ⚠️ linear slice approximation |
| Family types catalog (.txt) | ❌ import/export next |
| Shared parameter file (.txt) | ⚠️ data model only |

## Verify

After wiring:

```bash
npm run typecheck
# optional: extend scripts/verify-v54.mjs to assert
#   evaluateParameters + buildParametricFamily on a door with formulas
```

```

```md
# OpenBIMStudio - Revit gaps, Milestone 1

Milestone 1 turns four things that were shown as "done" but did nothing into working features, and adds the
first real Revit-interchange path (IFC export of the authored model).

## Install (3 steps)

1. Copy `src/modules/revit-gaps/` from this package into your project's `src/modules/`.
2. `node scripts/install-revit-gaps.mjs <projectRoot>` (add `--dry-run` first if you like).
   It makes three small edits, marker `openbim-revit-gaps:v1`, keeps originals in `.revit-gaps-backup/`, preserves
   CRLF/LF, and tells you if an anchor was not found instead of guessing:
   - `src/critical-gaps-boot.ts` - starts the revit-gaps boot
   - `src/shell/file-menu.ts` - File > Export > Model -> IFC4 / IFC2X3
   - `src/modules/export/native-twin-ifc.ts` - valid IFC GlobalIds
3. `npx tsc --noEmit` then `npm run dev`. The console prints `[revit-gaps] <version>: N/N steps started` (5/5 for M1 alone, 6/6 with M2).
   (the command palette entry "Revit gaps: show status" prints the table again.)

To run the tests: copy `tests/` next to `package.json` and run `node tests/run-tests.mjs`.

## What changed

| Gap found in the review | Now |
|---|---|
| Hide / Isolate / category overrides / phase filter / design options changed nothing in the viewport (the filter's change event had no subscribers) | `visibility-bridge.ts` applies the filter to authored meshes (visibility + halftone opacity, re-applied after every rebuild) and to Fragments models through `OBC.Hider` (`set`, `isolate`, categories via `model.getItemsOfCategories`) |
| `selection.getSelectedIds()` did not exist, so the Hide / Isolate / Group buttons always got an empty list | added; returns authored ids plus `frag:<modelId>::<localId>` keys |
| Nothing ever wrote `phaseCreated` / `phaseDemolished` / `designOptionId` on elements | palette commands "Phase: set ... on selection" and "Design option: assign selection" (tags live in `element.properties`) |
| Rooms: "Create Room" made a fixed 4x3 m rectangle at the origin | `room-detect.ts` + `room-tool.ts`: click inside walls (or `RM`) -> room on the wall finish faces; "Place rooms automatically"; islands (shafts) become holes; tags + outlines in the viewport. The old sample call is routed to automatic placement |
| Rooms / areas / phases / design options / groups / ref planes / shared params / copy-monitor lived in global localStorage (leaked across projects, missing from the saved project and Project JSON) | `project-scope.ts`: stored in `project.revitStores`, swapped on project open/new. First run adopts what is already in localStorage |
| No IFC export of the authored model; native-twin writer emitted invalid GlobalIds | `authored-ifc.ts`: IFC4 and IFC2X3 writer (see below); `ifc-guid.ts`: real compressed GUIDs, stable per element id |

### IFC export coverage
Analytic extruded solids (editable in Revit/other tools): walls, slab / roof / ceiling polygons, columns, footings,
beams, braces, duct / pipe / cable tray / conduit runs, doors and windows with real openings in the host wall
(`IfcOpeningElement` + void + fill relations), equipment (box), rooms as `IfcSpace` with `BaseQuantities`. Native twins are
tessellated. Storeys come from levels; every element carries an `OpenBIMStudio` property set (element id, type, family,
all primitive `properties`) and a material when `properties.material` is set. Anything else (stairs, railings, curtain
walls placed by the parity buttons, trusses, fittings) is listed in the console as "not exported" - never silently dropped.

## How this was verified (and what was not)

Run here: 34 automated tests, all passing -
- GUIDs (round trip, 2000 random, deterministic ids), rooms (rectangle, L-shape against the analytic area, T-junction
  8 cm off the wall face, overshooting walls, dangling stub, island hole, separation line, open plan returns null);
- IFC output for IFC4 and IFC2X3: every `#ref` resolves, attribute counts per entity match the schema, GlobalIds valid and
  unique, REAL values carry a decimal point, wall origin/axis/profile/depth and door position asserted numerically,
  escaping, determinism;
- the visibility bridge against fake meshes, a fake Hider and a fake Fragments model.
The new modules typecheck (strict) against your own sources; the installer was tested on LF and CRLF copies, twice
(idempotent) with no new type errors.

NOT done here, please check on your machine:
1. **Open an exported file in a third-party reader** (Revit link / IfcOpenShell / BIMvision). I validated it with my own
   structural checker, not with Revit. Revit 2020 reads IFC2X3 everywhere; if it rejects the IFC4 file use the IFC2X3 item.
2. The DOM/three.js parts (room click tool, tags, preview, Hider calls) were typechecked and the Hider/visibility logic was
   run against mocks, but not executed in a browser.
3. The Fragments pattern used (`Hider.set` / `isolate` with a model-id map, `getItemsOfCategories`) matches the That Open
   components docs and the calls already used elsewhere in your code base.

## Known limits of M1 (honest list)
- Room tool works in the 3D view; the 2D plan panel is not wired yet. Rooms are not associative (they do not follow wall
  edits; re-run "place rooms automatically" or delete and re-place).
- IFC: straight wall extrusions (no mitred joins), pipes/conduits exported round although the app draws boxes, no
  `Pset_*Common` yet.
- Phase / design-option filters only act on authored elements that carry tags; linked IFC items cannot be phased.
- Tagging and room placement are not in the undo stack yet.
- `ChunkProject.ps1` probably corrupts non-ASCII text on Windows PowerShell 5.1 (144 of 269 source files showed
  double-encoded characters in the chunks). Use `Get-Content -Raw -Encoding UTF8` and write with
  `Out-File -Encoding utf8`. All files in this package are plain ASCII.

## Roadmap to Revit-level parity (what remains, in order)

Matching Revit "from all sides" is several milestones of work; this is the dependency order.

- **M2 - Authored model completeness.** Stairs, railings, ramps, curtain walls, sloped roofs, ceilings as real authored
  elements (level-hosted, click-placed, editable, scheduled, exported); wall joins and profile edit; plan-panel room
  placement and tags; Properties palette for instance/type parameters, phases and options; undo for all of it.
- **M3 - Documentation.** Plan / section / elevation views driven by rooms and phases, view templates and a Visibility/
  Graphics dialog, sheets, door / window / room tags, dimensions, room / door / window schedules, print.
- **M4 - Revit round trip (Revit 2020 add-in).** Extend RevitBatchExporter: FRAG plus a JSON sidecar with levels, rooms and
  boundaries, phases, worksets, schedules, sheets, families / types / parameters and ElementId <-> IFC GlobalId; import
  of authored elements back into Revit.
- **M5 - Worksharing.** Element-level ownership / locks, sync, conflict handling and presence instead of whole-project
  last-write-wins.
- **M6 - Hardening.** Remove dead code (COBie, BCF 2.1, federation, standards report, model-health and the enhanced formula
  engine exist but are unreachable), typed APIs instead of `as any`, one boot path, CI.

```
--- END FILE ---

```md
# OpenBIMStudio - Revit gaps, Milestone 2: real stairs, railings, ramps, curtain walls, roofs, ceilings

Before M2 these types had no mesh in the authoring engine. The ST / RA / CW / RF / CL shortcuts were aliased to a box
("equipment"), a plain wall or a flat slab, and the ribbon's Place Stair / Railing / Curtain Wall buttons dropped fixed-size
scene objects at the origin that were not saved, selectable, scheduled or exported. M2 turns all six into ordinary authored
elements. This package is cumulative (M1 + M2).

## Install (upgrade from M1, or fresh)

1. Copy `src/modules/revit-gaps/` over your project's folder (10 files, all plain ASCII).
2. `node scripts/install-revit-gaps.mjs <projectRoot>` (use `--dry-run` first if you like). It is idempotent and now makes six
   small edits (M1: boot hook, File menu, native-twin GlobalIds. M2: `createMesh` asks `window.__obsMeshBuilders` for unknown
   types, cost takeoff gets rows for the new types, the three parity buttons start the click tools). Originals go to
   `.revit-gaps-backup/`; CRLF/LF is preserved; an anchor that is not found is reported, never guessed.
3. `npx tsc --noEmit`, `npm run dev`. Console: `[revit-gaps] 1.1.0-m2: 6/6 steps started` (7/7 with M3).
4. Tests: copy `tests/` next to `package.json`, `node tests/run-tests.mjs` (works on Windows).

## Using it

| Element | Start it | Interaction |
|---|---|---|
| Stairs (straight / L / U) | existing Stairs tool or shortcut, ribbon button, palette: "Stairs: straight run / L-shape / U-shape" | click start, click end of the first flight (Shift = orthogonal) |
| Railing | Railing tool / palette "Railing: draw path" | click points, double-click or Enter to finish |
| Ramp | palette "Ramp: place" | click start, click end |
| Curtain wall | Curtain wall tool / ribbon / palette | click start, click end |
| Roof (gable / shed) | Roof tool / palette "Roof: draw footprint" | click footprint points, double-click or Enter |
| Ceiling | Ceiling tool / palette, or "Ceiling: place one in every room of this level" | polygon, or automatic from rooms |

Everything snaps to existing end points / vertices (25 cm) and a 5 cm grid; Esc cancels. Elements are placed on the active
level; stairs and curtain walls take their height from the next level above (3.0 / 3.6 m when there is none). Each placement
is one undo step. Placed elements can be selected, moved / copied / rotated, edited with grips (stair run line, curtain wall and
ramp end points, railing and roof / ceiling vertices) and in the Properties palette (new schemas for all six types).

| Type | Main parameters (palette) |
|---|---|
| stairs | total rise, run width, shape (straight / L / U), turn direction, max riser (17.5 cm), waist, second flight length, gap (U), landing thickness |
| railing | rail height, rail size, rise along path (for stair railings), post spacing, baluster spacing, balusters on/off |
| ramp | rise, width, slab thickness (the ramp reports its slope and whether it is within 1:12) |
| curtain wall | height, mullion depth / width, horizontal and vertical grid spacing |
| roof | eaves elevation, thickness, type (gable / shed), slope in degrees, slope direction |
| ceiling | elevation, thickness |

## What else now works for them

- **Hide / isolate / category / phase / design option** (M1 bridge): they use the same mesh tagging, so they work with no extra code.
- **Cost takeoff**: real quantities (stairs: length, plan area, concrete volume and riser count; curtain wall: area; roof: sloped
  surface area and volume; railing: length; ramp: slope).
- **IFC export** (File > Export > Model): `IfcStair` (straight / quarter turn / half turn), `IfcRailing`, `IfcRamp`,
  `IfcCurtainWall` (frame and glazing as two coloured items), roofs as `IfcSlab` ROOF, ceilings as `IfcCovering`. Stairs, railings,
  ramps, curtain walls and roofs are tessellated from the same generators as the viewport, with storey-relative placement,
  quantities and the `OpenBIMStudio` property set. In IFC2X3 they are faceted breps and `IfcCurtainWall` has no predefined type.

## How it was verified, and what was not

Run here: **64 automated tests, all passing** (M1: 13 geometry/GUID/room, 11 visibility; M2: 19 geometry, 7 tools / registration, IFC grew
from 10 to 14).
- Geometry: every generated shell is closed with outward winding (edge-matching check, signed volume), the stair result is
  identical for any run direction, exact analytic volumes (waist-slab flight cross-section, ramp, roof = plan area x
  thickness, ceiling), L and U stairs: flights + landing sum exactly, second flight on the correct side, top at exactly the total
  rise; mullions keep their cross-section on rotated walls.
- Tools: snapping, defaults produce valid geometry for all six types, the stair rise follows the next level, one undo step
  reverts a placement, ceilings from rooms (no duplicates), palette schemas have no duplicate fields, mesh builder returns null
  instead of throwing on bad parameters, legacy tool names are redirected and all other tools pass through.
- IFC: attribute counts per entity for IFC4 and IFC2X3, valid unique GlobalIds, resolved references, tessellation indices in
  range, storey-relative heights, stair shapes mapped to the right enumerations.
- Compiles under your own `tsconfig` flags (isolatedModules, noImplicitReturns, ...); the installer was run twice on LF and CRLF
  copies with no new type errors.

NOT verified, please check on your machine:
1. The click tools, preview and snapping were never run in a browser (the DOM / three.js parts are typechecked and covered with fakes).
2. Open an exported IFC in Revit or another reader (my validator is my own; use the IFC2X3 item if Revit 2020 rejects IFC4).
3. The 2D plan panel (156 KB, not read in this review): I did not check how it draws the new types.

## Limits (deliberately not done yet)

- Stairs are monolithic waist-slab steps: no separate treads / risers / stringers / nosings, no winders or spirals, rectangular
  landings, and no automatic railings (draw a railing and set "Rise along path"). The run length includes the top step.
- Stairs and ramps do not cut openings in the floor above; roofs do not join or trim walls; there are no hip / valley roofs and no
  holes in roof or ceiling polygons. Curtain walls: uniform grid, no panel types, no doors in them, no corner mullions.
- Rooms (M1) and palette edits are still outside the undo stack unless the palette already records them.

## Still open from the original M2 list

Wall joins and profile edit (the engine already has corner join helpers; not touched), room placement and tags in the **plan panel**,
phases / design options in the Properties palette (today: palette commands from M1), and shaft / floor openings for stairs.
Next milestones are unchanged: M3 documentation (views, sheets, tags, schedules), M4 Revit 2020 round trip, M5 worksharing, M6 hardening.

```md
# OpenBIMStudio - Revit gaps, Milestone 3 (part 1): drawings that show the model

M3 is the documentation milestone. Before building anything I traced the real drawing pipeline (views -> scene -> sheet SVG /
PDF). Findings, then what this package changes.

## What I found

| Area | Finding (verified in the code) |
|---|---|
| Plans | The generator had no rooms at all (the `room` text kind existed but nothing produced it) and no poche. Stairs, ramps and curtain walls fell into a generic "thin box" branch, **railings were drawn as closed loops**, roofs and ceilings as plain outlines. No door / window marks. |
| Elevations | Every element was its bounding rectangle: no door / window openings, no hidden surfaces (everything drawn, nothing occluded), no roof slope, no glazing. |
| Sections | Walls were cut as if always perpendicular to the cut line (thickness used as width), no openings, stairs and roofs as rectangles. |
| Sheet PDF | Polygon fills use pdf-lib `drawSvgPath(d, {x:0, y:0})` with page coordinates that are already y-up; `drawSvgPath` is y-down, so those fills very probably fall below the page (poche, tag bubbles, glazing would be missing in printed sheets). I could not run pdf-lib here, so treat this as "probable, from reading the code". |
| View templates | `ViewDef.templateId` exists but nothing reads it. There is no per-view Visibility/Graphics for 2D views. |
| Two systems | The old plan panel (`plan-view-panel.ts`, 156 KB) has its own drawing code. Sheets and PDF use the newer Scene2D pipeline (`modules/views`). M3 changes the Scene2D pipeline; the old panel is untouched. |

## What changed

**Plans** (`m3-plan.ts`)
- Wall and column **poche**, broken at the door / window openings the cut plane passes through.
- **Room tags** (number, name, area) from the rooms of that level (matched by elevation), optional boundaries.
- **Stair symbols**: flight outlines, riser lines (solid up to the cut plane, dashed above), up arrow and "UP", landings, L / U shapes.
- Railings as double lines, ramps with arrow and slope (1:12.0), curtain walls with mullion ticks and a glazing line, roofs as
  dashed outline with ridge and slope, ceilings on reflected ceiling plans only.
- **Door and window marks** (D1, W1 ... in element order, or `properties.mark`) in tag circles.
- The base generator's geometry for the six M2 types is dropped so nothing is drawn twice.

**Elevations** (`m3-project.ts`): real geometry - walls with openings, door leaves and frames, translucent glazing, sloped roofs,
stairs. Each connected piece contributes its front-facing triangles; nearer pieces hide farther ones; crease lines are drawn
where faces bend; level datums are added.

**Sections**: closed solids are cut by the plane. The cap of every cut solid is rebuilt (poche, holes punched), so oblique cuts
have the right width, a cut through a door shows only the lintel, a cut along a stair shows the stepped waist-slab profile, and
what lies beyond is drawn as projection. "Right" / "left" look directions are never mirrored. Level datums are added.

**PDF**: filled polygons are drawn with raw PDF path operators in page coordinates (`m3-pdf-fill.ts`); the old path is the fallback.

## Install

1. Copy `src/modules/revit-gaps/` (now 15 files) over the project's folder.
2. `node scripts/install-revit-gaps.mjs <projectRoot>` (`--dry-run` first if you like). It is idempotent, now eleven small edits in
   ten files; the new ones are in `generators/plan.ts` (two lines), `section.ts`, `elevation.ts` and `export/pdf.ts`.
3. `npx tsc --noEmit`, `npm run dev`. Console: `[revit-gaps] 1.2.0-m3: 7/7 steps started`.
4. Run the palette command **"Views: regenerate all views and sheets"** once (sheets cache scenes), then open a plan, section,
   elevation and a sheet.
5. Tests: copy `tests/` next to `package.json`, `node tests/run-tests.mjs`.

Palette commands: "Plan graphics: toggle wall poche / room tags / room boundaries / door and window marks / stair symbols" and
"Views: regenerate all views and sheets". Choices persist.

## How it was verified, and what was not

Run here: **96 automated tests, all passing** (32 of them new in M3). For M3: exact wall-with-openings volumes; closed solids; painter order;
oblique cut width = thickness / sin(angle); cut through a door = lintel only; stair cap area = analytic cross-section; clipping
conserves surface area for both look directions at several positions; poche areas with and without openings; riser lines below
and above the cut; ridge position; marks and tag placement; room matching by elevation; hooks into the real generator
signatures; PDF operator sequence, white blending of translucent fills and fallbacks. Everything compiles under your own
`tsconfig` flags and the installer was run twice on LF and CRLF copies with no new type errors.

NOT verified, please check:
1. **Open a sheet and print a PDF** with a plan, a section and an elevation. In particular confirm poche and glazing now show
   in the PDF (and say if they already did - then the fix is harmless).
2. Nothing was run in a browser; the generators were exercised through their real hook signatures with fake data.
3. Orientation: your plan panel draws +Z up ("north up") while the 3D world is right-handed with Y up, so a plan with X to the
   right is the mirror of the 3D top view. M1's IFC export keeps the 3D geometry (IFC X = x, Y = -z). If you design in the plan
   panel and the exported IFC looks flipped north-south against it, tell me which one should win and I will change the mapping.

## Limits (not done yet)

- No hatch patterns (neither renderer draws hatches): poche is one colour per type.
- Depth ordering is per connected piece (far to near); interpenetrating or very large overlapping solids can mis-order.
- Views ignore phase / design-option filters and the section's top / bottom crop; truss, fitting and grid elements are not drawn.
- Door / room tags are generated from element data on every regeneration (not movable annotations).
- Plan symbols are not in the old plan panel.

## Still open in M3

View templates and a Visibility/Graphics dialog (the `templateId` plumbing), automatic dimensions, schedules for rooms / doors /
windows / the M2 types linked to the marks, section and elevation markers on plans, callouts / detail views, print preview and
sheet checks. Then M4 (Revit 2020 round trip), M5 (worksharing), M6 (hardening).

```
--- END FILE ---

--- FILE: docs/REVIT_INPUT_PARITY.md ---
```md
# Revit Input Parity — Camera, View, Mouse, Keyboard

## Mouse (matches Revit default 3D navigation)

| Action | Behaviour |
|--------|-----------|
| **MMB drag** | Pan |
| **Shift + MMB drag** | Orbit around target |
| **Ctrl + MMB drag** | Orbit around selection |
| **Scroll wheel** | Zoom to cursor |
| **Shift + Wheel** | Zoom ×3 |
| **Double-click MMB** | Zoom to fit |
| **LMB click** | Select |
| **LMB drag L→R** | Window select |
| **LMB drag R→L** | Crossing select |
| **RMB** | Context menu |

Implemented in `navigation.ts` + `revit-mouse-policy.ts` + `input-router.ts`.  
CameraControls mouse buttons are forced **OFF** so only this map drives the view (`revit-input-parity` re-asserts every 4s).

## Keyboard — view

| Keys | Action |
|------|--------|
| **ZA / ZF / ZE** | Zoom all / fit / extents |
| **ZI / ZO** | Zoom in / out |
| **VN** | Default 3D (home) view |
| **F** | Fit to view |
| **H** | Home view |
| **HH / HI / HR** | Hide / Isolate / Reset temporary |
| **Ctrl+W** | Walk mode |
| **Ctrl+/** | Mouse & keyboard help overlay |

## Keyboard — modify

| Keys | Action |
|------|--------|
| **MV / G** | Move |
| **RO / R** | Rotate |
| **S** | Scale |
| **AL** | Align |
| **MA** | Match properties |
| **CS** | Create similar |
| **GP** | Create group |
| **Delete** | Delete |
| **Esc** | Cancel / clear |
| **Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Y** | Undo / Redo |

## Keyboard — architecture tools

| Keys | Tool |
|------|------|
| **WA** | Wall |
| **SL** | Slab |
| **CM** | Column |
| **BM** | Beam |
| **DR / WN** | Door / Window |
| **GR / LV** | Grid / Level |
| **ST / RA** | Stairs / Railing |
| **CW** | Curtain wall |
| **RM** | Room |
| **RF / CL** | Roof / Ceiling |
| **DU / PP** | Duct / Pipe |

Two-letter sequences use an ~800 ms buffer (same idea as Revit).

## Help UI

- **Ctrl+/** — full mouse + keyboard map overlay  
- Command Center → **Mouse & Keys**  
- Command palette → “Mouse & Keyboard Help”

## Files

| File | Role |
|------|------|
| `features/navigation.ts` | MMB pan / Shift-orbit / wheel zoom (canonical) |
| `core/revit-mouse-policy.ts` | MMB flags, no zoom during pan, block click after drag |
| `core/input-router.ts` | Gesture ownership |
| `core/wheel-arbiter.ts` | Wheel conflict resolution |
| `features/selection-orbit.ts` | Pivot on LMB selection only |
| `shell/default-shortcuts.ts` | Base tool + app shortcuts |
| `features/revit-input-parity.ts` | Missing Revit keys + help overlay + nav guard |

```

--- FILE: NavisworksGLBExporter/Navsiworks GLB expoeter/Build-NavisworksGLBExporter.ps1 ---
```powershell
﻿# Navisworks 2025 GLB Exporter - Build & Deploy

$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"

$ProjectName       = "NavisworksGLBExporter"
$CompanyName       = "MYCOMPANY"
$NavisworksYear    = "2025"
$NavisworksSeries  = "Nw22"

$RootDir           = "D:\Automation\Open BIM Studio\OpenBIMStudio\NavisworksGLBExporter"
$SrcDir            = Join-Path $RootDir "src"
$BuildDir          = Join-Path $RootDir "build"
$BundleDir         = Join-Path $env:APPDATA "Autodesk\ApplicationPlugins\$ProjectName.bundle"
$BundleContentsDir = Join-Path $BundleDir "Contents\v$NavisworksSeries"

Write-Host "=============================================" -ForegroundColor Cyan
Write-Host " Navisworks 2025 GLB Exporter Setup" -ForegroundColor Cyan
Write-Host "=============================================" -ForegroundColor Cyan

# ---------- STEP 1: Locate Navisworks DLLs ----------
Write-Host ""
Write-Host "[1/6] Locating Navisworks DLLs..." -ForegroundColor Yellow

$NavisworksDir = "C:\Program Files\Autodesk\Navisworks Manage $NavisworksYear"
if (-not (Test-Path $NavisworksDir)) {
    $NavisworksDir = "C:\Program Files\Autodesk\Navisworks Simulate $NavisworksYear"
}
if (-not (Test-Path $NavisworksDir)) {
    Write-Host "ERROR: Navisworks $NavisworksYear not found." -ForegroundColor Red
    exit 1
}
Write-Host "  Dir: $NavisworksDir" -ForegroundColor Green

$NwApiPath     = Join-Path $NavisworksDir "Autodesk.Navisworks.Api.dll"
$NwComApiPath  = Join-Path $NavisworksDir "Autodesk.Navisworks.ComApi.dll"
$NwInteropPath = Join-Path $NavisworksDir "Autodesk.Navisworks.Interop.ComApi.dll"
$AdWinPath     = Join-Path $NavisworksDir "AdWindows.dll"

foreach ($dll in @($NwApiPath, $NwComApiPath, $NwInteropPath, $AdWinPath)) {
    if (-not (Test-Path $dll)) {
        Write-Host "ERROR: Missing DLL: $dll" -ForegroundColor Red
        exit 1
    }
    Write-Host "  Found: $(Split-Path $dll -Leaf)" -ForegroundColor Green
}

# Known assembly + namespace values (verified from earlier inspection)
$ApiAsmName     = "Autodesk.Navisworks.Api"
$ComApiAsmName  = "Autodesk.Navisworks.ComApi"
$InteropAsmName = "Autodesk.Navisworks.Interop.ComApi"
$AdWinAsmName   = "AdWindows"
$InteropNs      = "Autodesk.Navisworks.Api.Interop.ComApi"
$BridgeNs       = "Autodesk.Navisworks.Api.ComApi"

# ---------- STEP 2: Locate MSBuild ----------
Write-Host ""
Write-Host "[2/6] Locating MSBuild..." -ForegroundColor Yellow

$VsWhere = "${env:ProgramFiles(x86)}\Microsoft Visual Studio\Installer\vswhere.exe"
$MSBuild = $null
if (Test-Path $VsWhere) {
    $MSBuild = & $VsWhere -latest -requires Microsoft.Component.MSBuild -find "MSBuild\**\Bin\MSBuild.exe" | Select-Object -First 1
}
if (-not $MSBuild -or -not (Test-Path $MSBuild)) {
    foreach ($f in @(
        "C:\Program Files\Microsoft Visual Studio\2022\Community\MSBuild\Current\Bin\MSBuild.exe",
        "C:\Program Files\Microsoft Visual Studio\2022\Professional\MSBuild\Current\Bin\MSBuild.exe",
        "C:\Program Files\Microsoft Visual Studio\2022\Enterprise\MSBuild\Current\Bin\MSBuild.exe"
    )) { if (Test-Path $f) { $MSBuild = $f; break } }
}
if (-not $MSBuild) {
    Write-Host "ERROR: MSBuild not found." -ForegroundColor Red
    exit 1
}
Write-Host "  MSBuild: $MSBuild" -ForegroundColor Green

# ---------- STEP 3: Create directories ----------
Write-Host ""
Write-Host "[3/6] Creating directories..." -ForegroundColor Yellow

foreach ($d in @($RootDir, $SrcDir, $BuildDir, $BundleDir, $BundleContentsDir)) {
    if (-not (Test-Path $d)) {
        New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $d -Force | Out-Null
    }
}
Write-Host "  Ready." -ForegroundColor Green

# ---------- STEP 4: Write C# source files ----------
Write-Host ""
Write-Host "[4/6] Writing source files..." -ForegroundColor Yellow

$PluginCs = @"
using System;
using System.Windows.Forms;
using Autodesk.Navisworks.Api;
using Autodesk.Navisworks.Api.Plugins;

namespace NavisworksGLBExporter
{
    [Plugin("GLBExporter", "MYCOMPANY", DisplayName = "GLB Exporter")]
    [AddInPlugin(AddInLocation.AddIn)]
    public class GLBExporterPlugin : AddInPlugin
    {
        public override int Execute(params string[] parameters)
        {
            Document doc = Autodesk.Navisworks.Api.Application.ActiveDocument;
            if (doc == null)
            {
                MessageBox.Show("No document open.", "GLB Exporter");
                return 1;
            }

            using (SaveFileDialog sfd = new SaveFileDialog())
            {
                sfd.Filter = "GLB File (*.glb)|*.glb";
                sfd.Title = "Save selection as GLB";
                sfd.FileName = "model.glb";
                if (sfd.ShowDialog() != DialogResult.OK) return 0;

                System.Windows.Forms.Cursor.Current = System.Windows.Forms.Cursors.WaitCursor;
                try
                {
                    new GLBModelExporter().Export(doc, sfd.FileName);
                    System.Windows.Forms.Cursor.Current = System.Windows.Forms.Cursors.Default;
                    MessageBox.Show("Export complete!\n\n" + sfd.FileName, "GLB Exporter");
                }
                catch (Exception ex)
                {
                    System.Windows.Forms.Cursor.Current = System.Windows.Forms.Cursors.Default;
                    MessageBox.Show("Export failed:\n\n" + ex.Message, "GLB Exporter");
                }
            }
            return 0;
        }
    }
}
"@

$ExporterCs = @"
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using Autodesk.Navisworks.Api;
using ComApi = $InteropNs;
using ComBridge = $BridgeNs.ComApiBridge;

namespace NavisworksGLBExporter
{
    public class GLBModelExporter : ComApi.InwSimplePrimitivesCB
    {
        private readonly List<float> _positions = new List<float>();
        private readonly List<float> _normals   = new List<float>();
        private readonly List<uint>  _indices   = new List<uint>();
        private uint _vertexOffset = 0;

        public void Export(Document doc, string filePath)
        {
            _positions.Clear();
            _normals.Clear();
            _indices.Clear();
            _vertexOffset = 0;

            ModelItemCollection modelItems = doc.CurrentSelection.SelectedItems;

            if (modelItems == null || modelItems.Count == 0)
            {
                throw new Exception("Nothing is selected. Please select items first.");
            }

            ComApi.InwOpState10 oState = ComBridge.State;
            ComApi.InwOpSelection oSel = ComBridge.ToInwOpSelection(modelItems);

            foreach (ComApi.InwOaPath3 path in oSel.Paths())
            {
                foreach (ComApi.InwOaFragment3 frag in path.Fragments())
                {
                    frag.GenerateSimplePrimitives(ComApi.nwEVertexProperty.eNORMAL, this);
                }
            }

            if (_positions.Count == 0)
                throw new Exception("No geometry extracted from the selected items.");

            GLBWriter.Write(filePath, _positions, _normals, _indices);
        }

        public void Triangle(ComApi.InwSimpleVertex v1,
                             ComApi.InwSimpleVertex v2,
                             ComApi.InwSimpleVertex v3)
        {
            AddVertex(v1); AddVertex(v2); AddVertex(v3);
            _indices.Add(_vertexOffset);
            _indices.Add(_vertexOffset + 1);
            _indices.Add(_vertexOffset + 2);
            _vertexOffset += 3;
        }

        private void AddVertex(ComApi.InwSimpleVertex v)
        {
            Array coord = (Array)v.coord;
            _positions.Add(Convert.ToSingle(coord.GetValue(0)));
            _positions.Add(Convert.ToSingle(coord.GetValue(1)));
            _positions.Add(Convert.ToSingle(coord.GetValue(2)));
            try
            {
                Array norm = (Array)v.normal;
                _normals.Add(Convert.ToSingle(norm.GetValue(0)));
                _normals.Add(Convert.ToSingle(norm.GetValue(1)));
                _normals.Add(Convert.ToSingle(norm.GetValue(2)));
            }
            catch
            {
                _normals.Add(0f);
                _normals.Add(0f);
                _normals.Add(1f);
            }
        }

        public void Line(ComApi.InwSimpleVertex v1, ComApi.InwSimpleVertex v2) { }
        public void Point(ComApi.InwSimpleVertex v) { }
        public void SnapPoint(ComApi.InwSimpleVertex v) { }
    }
}
"@

$GlbWriterCs = @'
using System;
using System.IO;
using System.Text;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Globalization;

namespace NavisworksGLBExporter
{
    public static class GLBWriter
    {
        public static void Write(string filePath,
                                 List<float> positions,
                                 List<float> normals,
                                 List<uint>  indices)
        {
            int vertexCount = positions.Count / 3;

            float minX = float.MaxValue, minY = float.MaxValue, minZ = float.MaxValue;
            float maxX = float.MinValue, maxY = float.MinValue, maxZ = float.MinValue;
            for (int i = 0; i < positions.Count; i += 3)
            {
                float x = positions[i], y = positions[i + 1], z = positions[i + 2];
                if (x < minX) minX = x; if (x > maxX) maxX = x;
                if (y < minY) minY = y; if (y > maxY) maxY = y;
                if (z < minZ) minZ = z; if (z > maxZ) maxZ = z;
            }

            byte[] posBytes = new byte[positions.Count * 4];
            Buffer.BlockCopy(positions.ToArray(), 0, posBytes, 0, posBytes.Length);
            byte[] nrmBytes = new byte[normals.Count * 4];
            Buffer.BlockCopy(normals.ToArray(), 0, nrmBytes, 0, nrmBytes.Length);
            byte[] idxBytes = new byte[indices.Count * 4];
            Buffer.BlockCopy(indices.ToArray(), 0, idxBytes, 0, idxBytes.Length);

            int idxPad = (4 - (idxBytes.Length % 4)) % 4;
            int posOffset = 0;
            int nrmOffset = posBytes.Length;
            int idxOffset = nrmOffset + nrmBytes.Length;
            int totalBinarySize = idxOffset + idxBytes.Length + idxPad;

            byte[] binaryBuffer = new byte[totalBinarySize];
            Buffer.BlockCopy(posBytes, 0, binaryBuffer, posOffset, posBytes.Length);
            Buffer.BlockCopy(nrmBytes, 0, binaryBuffer, nrmOffset, nrmBytes.Length);
            Buffer.BlockCopy(idxBytes, 0, binaryBuffer, idxOffset, idxBytes.Length);

            var inv = CultureInfo.InvariantCulture;
            string json = "{"
                + "\"asset\":{\"version\":\"2.0\",\"generator\":\"Navisworks GLB Exporter\"},"
                + "\"scene\":0,"
                + "\"scenes\":[{\"nodes\":[0]}],"
                + "\"nodes\":[{\"mesh\":0}],"
                + "\"meshes\":[{\"primitives\":[{\"attributes\":{\"POSITION\":0,\"NORMAL\":1},\"indices\":2,\"mode\":4}]}],"
                + "\"accessors\":["
                    + "{\"bufferView\":0,\"componentType\":5126,\"count\":" + vertexCount + ",\"type\":\"VEC3\","
                    + "\"min\":[" + minX.ToString(inv) + "," + minY.ToString(inv) + "," + minZ.ToString(inv) + "],"
                    + "\"max\":[" + maxX.ToString(inv) + "," + maxY.ToString(inv) + "," + maxZ.ToString(inv) + "]},"
                    + "{\"bufferView\":1,\"componentType\":5126,\"count\":" + vertexCount + ",\"type\":\"VEC3\"},"
                    + "{\"bufferView\":2,\"componentType\":5125,\"count\":" + indices.Count + ",\"type\":\"SCALAR\"}"
                + "],"
                + "\"bufferViews\":["
                    + "{\"buffer\":0,\"byteOffset\":" + posOffset + ",\"byteLength\":" + posBytes.Length + ",\"target\":34962},"
                    + "{\"buffer\":0,\"byteOffset\":" + nrmOffset + ",\"byteLength\":" + nrmBytes.Length + ",\"target\":34962},"
                    + "{\"buffer\":0,\"byteOffset\":" + idxOffset + ",\"byteLength\":" + idxBytes.Length + ",\"target\":34963}"
                + "],"
                + "\"buffers\":[{\"byteLength\":" + totalBinarySize + "}]"
                + "}";

            byte[] jsonBytes = Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(json);
            int jsonPad = (4 - (jsonBytes.Length % 4)) % 4;
            int jsonChunkLen = jsonBytes.Length + jsonPad;
            int binaryChunkLen = totalBinarySize;
            int totalLength = 12 + 8 + jsonChunkLen + 8 + binaryChunkLen;

            using (var fs = new FileStream(filePath, FileMode.Create))
            using (var bw = new BinaryWriter(fs))
            {
                bw.Write(new byte[] { 0x67, 0x6C, 0x54, 0x46 });
                bw.Write(2);
                bw.Write(totalLength);
                bw.Write(jsonChunkLen);
                bw.Write(new byte[] { 0x4E, 0x4F, 0x53, 0x4A });
                bw.Write(jsonBytes);
                bw.Write(new byte[jsonPad]);
                bw.Write(binaryChunkLen);
                bw.Write(new byte[] { 0x00, 0x4E, 0x49, 0x42 });
                bw.Write(binaryBuffer);
            }
        }
    }
}
'@

$AssemblyInfoCs = @'

# ---------- STEP 6: Build & Deploy ----------

$PackageXml = @"

--- FILE: NavisworksGLBExporter/src/GLBExporterPlugin.cs ---
```csharp
﻿using System;
using WinForms = System.Windows.Forms;
using Autodesk.Navisworks.Api;
using Autodesk.Navisworks.Api.Plugins;

namespace NavisworksGLBExporter
{
    [Plugin("GLBExporter", "MYCOMPANY", DisplayName = "GLB Exporter")]
    [AddInPlugin(AddInLocation.AddIn)]
    public class GLBExporterPlugin : AddInPlugin
    {
        public override int Execute(params string[] parameters)
        {
            Document doc = Autodesk.Navisworks.Api.Application.ActiveDocument;
            if (doc == null)
            {
                WinForms.MessageBox.Show("No document open.", "GLB Exporter");
                return 1;
            }

            using (WinForms.SaveFileDialog sfd = new WinForms.SaveFileDialog())
            {
                sfd.Filter = "GLB File (*.glb)|*.glb";
                sfd.Title = "Save as GLB";
                sfd.FileName = "model.glb";
                if (sfd.ShowDialog() != WinForms.DialogResult.OK) return 0;

                WinForms.Cursor.Current = WinForms.Cursors.WaitCursor;
                try
                {
                    new GLBModelExporter().Export(doc, sfd.FileName);
                    WinForms.Cursor.Current = WinForms.Cursors.Default;
                }
                catch (Exception ex)
                {
                    WinForms.Cursor.Current = WinForms.Cursors.Default;
                    WinForms.MessageBox.Show("Export failed:\n\n" + ex.Message, "GLB Exporter");
                }
            }
            return 0;
        }
    }
}

--- FILE: NavisworksGLBExporter/src/GLBModelExporter.cs ---
```csharp
﻿using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Text;
using System.Windows.Forms;
using Autodesk.Navisworks.Api;
using ComApi = Autodesk.Navisworks.Api.Interop.ComApi;
using ComBridge = Autodesk.Navisworks.Api.ComApi.ComApiBridge;

namespace NavisworksGLBExporter
{
    public class GLBModelExporter : ComApi.InwSimplePrimitivesCB
    {
        private readonly List<float> _positions = new List<float>();
        private readonly List<float> _normals   = new List<float>();
        private readonly List<uint>  _indices   = new List<uint>();
        private uint _vertexOffset = 0;
        private int _triangleCount = 0;
        private int _lineCount = 0;
        private int _pointCount = 0;
        private int _coordErrorCount = 0;
        private string _coordDiag = null;
        private float _minX = float.MaxValue, _minY = float.MaxValue, _minZ = float.MaxValue;
        private float _maxX = float.MinValue, _maxY = float.MinValue, _maxZ = float.MinValue;

        public void Export(Document doc, string filePath)
        {
            _positions.Clear(); _normals.Clear(); _indices.Clear();
            _vertexOffset = 0;
            _triangleCount = 0; _lineCount = 0; _pointCount = 0;
            _coordErrorCount = 0; _coordDiag = null;
            _minX = _minY = _minZ = float.MaxValue;
            _maxX = _maxY = _maxZ = float.MinValue;

            ModelItemCollection items = doc.CurrentSelection.SelectedItems;
            string label;
            if (items == null || items.Count == 0)
            {
                items = new ModelItemCollection();
                foreach (ModelItem it in doc.Models.RootItemDescendants) items.Add(it);
                label = "ENTIRE MODEL";
            }
            else label = "SELECTION";

            StringBuilder diag = new StringBuilder();
            diag.AppendLine("Source: " + label);
            diag.AppendLine("Items: " + items.Count);

            ComApi.InwOpState10 oState = ComBridge.State;
            ComApi.InwOpSelection oSel = ComBridge.ToInwOpSelection(items);

            int pathCount = 0, fragCount = 0, fragWithGeom = 0;
            foreach (ComApi.InwOaPath3 path in oSel.Paths())
            {
                pathCount++;
                ComApi.InwNodeFragsColl frags = path.Fragments();
                if (frags == null) continue;

                for (int fi = 1; fi <= frags.Count; fi++)
                {
                    ComApi.InwOaFragment3 frag = (ComApi.InwOaFragment3)frags[fi];
                    fragCount++;
                    int before = _positions.Count;
                    try
                    {
                        frag.GenerateSimplePrimitives(
                            ComApi.nwEVertexProperty.eNORMAL | ComApi.nwEVertexProperty.eCOLOR,
                            this);
                    }
                    catch (Exception ex) { diag.AppendLine("Fragment error: " + ex.Message); }
                    if (_positions.Count > before) fragWithGeom++;
                }
            }

            diag.AppendLine("Paths: " + pathCount);
            diag.AppendLine("Fragments: " + fragCount);
            diag.AppendLine("Fragments with geometry: " + fragWithGeom);
            diag.AppendLine("Vertices: " + (_positions.Count / 3));
            diag.AppendLine("Triangles: " + _triangleCount);
            if (_positions.Count > 0)
            {
                diag.AppendLine("Bounds X: " + _minX.ToString("F2") + " .. " + _maxX.ToString("F2"));
                diag.AppendLine("Bounds Y: " + _minY.ToString("F2") + " .. " + _maxY.ToString("F2"));
                diag.AppendLine("Bounds Z: " + _minZ.ToString("F2") + " .. " + _maxZ.ToString("F2"));
            }
            if (_coordErrorCount > 0)
                diag.AppendLine("Coord errors: " + _coordErrorCount);
            if (_coordDiag != null)
                diag.AppendLine("Coord diag: " + _coordDiag);

            if (_positions.Count == 0)
            {
                MessageBox.Show(diag.ToString(), "GLB Exporter - Diagnostics");
                return;
            }

            GLBWriter.Write(filePath, _positions, _normals, _indices);
            diag.AppendLine();
            diag.AppendLine("Saved: " + filePath);
            MessageBox.Show(diag.ToString(), "GLB Exporter - Success");
        }

        public void Triangle(ComApi.InwSimpleVertex v1,
                             ComApi.InwSimpleVertex v2,
                             ComApi.InwSimpleVertex v3)
        {
            _triangleCount++;
            AddVertex(v1); AddVertex(v2); AddVertex(v3);
            _indices.Add(_vertexOffset);
            _indices.Add(_vertexOffset + 1);
            _indices.Add(_vertexOffset + 2);
            _vertexOffset += 3;
        }

                private void AddVertex(ComApi.InwSimpleVertex v)
        {
            // Read raw coordinates (Navisworks is Z-up)
            float x = 0, y = 0, z = 0;
            bool ok = false;

            object co = null;
            try { co = v.coord; } catch { }

            if (co != null)
            {
                try
                {
                    Array ca = co as Array;
                    if (ca != null)
                    {
                        int lo = ca.GetLowerBound(0);
                        int hi = ca.GetUpperBound(0);
                        if (hi - lo >= 2)
                        {
                            x = Convert.ToSingle(ca.GetValue(lo));
                            y = Convert.ToSingle(ca.GetValue(lo + 1));
                            z = Convert.ToSingle(ca.GetValue(lo + 2));
                            ok = true;
                        }
                    }
                }
                catch { }
                if (!ok)
                {
                    try
                    {
                        float[] cf = co as float[];
                        if (cf != null && cf.Length >= 3)
                        {
                            x = cf[0]; y = cf[1]; z = cf[2]; ok = true;
                        }
                    }
                    catch { }
                }
            }

            if (!ok) _coordErrorCount++;

            // Convert Z-up (Navisworks) to Y-up (glTF spec)
            float rx =  x;
            float ry =  z;
            float rz = -y;

            _positions.Add(rx); _positions.Add(ry); _positions.Add(rz);
            if (rx < _minX) _minX = rx; if (rx > _maxX) _maxX = rx;
            if (ry < _minY) _minY = ry; if (ry > _maxY) _maxY = ry;
            if (rz < _minZ) _minZ = rz; if (rz > _maxZ) _maxZ = rz;

            // Normals: same rotation
            float nx = 0, ny = 0, nz = 1;
            try
            {
                object no = v.normal;
                if (no != null)
                {
                    Array na = no as Array;
                    if (na != null)
                    {
                        int lo = na.GetLowerBound(0);
                        int hi = na.GetUpperBound(0);
                        if (hi - lo >= 2)
                        {
                            nx = Convert.ToSingle(na.GetValue(lo));
                            ny = Convert.ToSingle(na.GetValue(lo + 1));
                            nz = Convert.ToSingle(na.GetValue(lo + 2));
                        }
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        float[] nf = no as float[];
                        if (nf != null && nf.Length >= 3)
                        {
                            nx = nf[0]; ny = nf[1]; nz = nf[2];
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            catch { }

            _normals.Add(nx); _normals.Add(nz); _normals.Add(-ny);
        }

        public void Line(ComApi.InwSimpleVertex v1, ComApi.InwSimpleVertex v2) { _lineCount++; }
        public void Point(ComApi.InwSimpleVertex v) { _pointCount++; }
        public void SnapPoint(ComApi.InwSimpleVertex v) { }
    }
}

--- FILE: NavisworksGLBExporter/src/GLBWriter.cs ---
```csharp
﻿using System;
using System.IO;
using System.Text;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Globalization;

namespace NavisworksGLBExporter
{
    public static class GLBWriter
    {
        public static void Write(string filePath,
                                 List<float> positions,
                                 List<float> normals,
                                 List<uint>  indices)
        {
            int vertexCount = positions.Count / 3;

            float minX = float.MaxValue, minY = float.MaxValue, minZ = float.MaxValue;
            float maxX = float.MinValue, maxY = float.MinValue, maxZ = float.MinValue;
            for (int i = 0; i < positions.Count; i += 3)
            {
                float x = positions[i], y = positions[i+1], z = positions[i+2];
                if (x < minX) minX = x; if (x > maxX) maxX = x;
                if (y < minY) minY = y; if (y > maxY) maxY = y;
                if (z < minZ) minZ = z; if (z > maxZ) maxZ = z;
            }

            byte[] posBytes = new byte[positions.Count * 4];
            Buffer.BlockCopy(positions.ToArray(), 0, posBytes, 0, posBytes.Length);
            byte[] nrmBytes = new byte[normals.Count * 4];
            Buffer.BlockCopy(normals.ToArray(), 0, nrmBytes, 0, nrmBytes.Length);
            byte[] idxBytes = new byte[indices.Count * 4];
            Buffer.BlockCopy(indices.ToArray(), 0, idxBytes, 0, idxBytes.Length);

            int idxPad = (4 - (idxBytes.Length % 4)) % 4;
            int posOffset = 0;
            int nrmOffset = posBytes.Length;
            int idxOffset = nrmOffset + nrmBytes.Length;
            int totalBinarySize = idxOffset + idxBytes.Length + idxPad;

            byte[] binaryBuffer = new byte[totalBinarySize];
            Buffer.BlockCopy(posBytes, 0, binaryBuffer, posOffset, posBytes.Length);
            Buffer.BlockCopy(nrmBytes, 0, binaryBuffer, nrmOffset, nrmBytes.Length);
            Buffer.BlockCopy(idxBytes, 0, binaryBuffer, idxOffset, idxBytes.Length);

            var inv = CultureInfo.InvariantCulture;
            string json = "{"
                + "\"asset\":{\"version\":\"2.0\",\"generator\":\"Navisworks GLB Exporter\"},"
                + "\"scene\":0,"
                + "\"scenes\":[{\"nodes\":[0]}],"
                + "\"nodes\":[{\"mesh\":0}],"
                + "\"meshes\":[{\"primitives\":[{\"attributes\":{\"POSITION\":0,\"NORMAL\":1},\"indices\":2,\"mode\":4}]}],"
                + "\"accessors\":["
                    + "{\"bufferView\":0,\"componentType\":5126,\"count\":" + vertexCount + ",\"type\":\"VEC3\","
                    + "\"min\":[" + minX.ToString(inv) + "," + minY.ToString(inv) + "," + minZ.ToString(inv) + "],"
                    + "\"max\":[" + maxX.ToString(inv) + "," + maxY.ToString(inv) + "," + maxZ.ToString(inv) + "]},"
                    + "{\"bufferView\":1,\"componentType\":5126,\"count\":" + vertexCount + ",\"type\":\"VEC3\"},"
                    + "{\"bufferView\":2,\"componentType\":5125,\"count\":" + indices.Count + ",\"type\":\"SCALAR\"}"
                + "],"
                + "\"bufferViews\":["
                    + "{\"buffer\":0,\"byteOffset\":" + posOffset + ",\"byteLength\":" + posBytes.Length + ",\"target\":34962},"
                    + "{\"buffer\":0,\"byteOffset\":" + nrmOffset + ",\"byteLength\":" + nrmBytes.Length + ",\"target\":34962},"
                    + "{\"buffer\":0,\"byteOffset\":" + idxOffset + ",\"byteLength\":" + idxBytes.Length + ",\"target\":34963}"
                + "],"
                + "\"buffers\":[{\"byteLength\":" + totalBinarySize + "}]"
                + "}";

            byte[] jsonBytes = Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(json);
            int jsonPad = (4 - (jsonBytes.Length % 4)) % 4;
            int jsonChunkLen = jsonBytes.Length + jsonPad;
            int binaryChunkLen = totalBinarySize;
            int totalLength = 12 + 8 + jsonChunkLen + 8 + binaryChunkLen;

            using (var fs = new FileStream(filePath, FileMode.Create))
            using (var bw = new BinaryWriter(fs))
            {
                bw.Write(new byte[] { 0x67, 0x6C, 0x54, 0x46 });
                bw.Write(2);
                bw.Write(totalLength);
                bw.Write(jsonChunkLen);
                bw.Write(new byte[] { 0x4A, 0x53, 0x4F, 0x4E });
                bw.Write(jsonBytes);
                byte[] jsonPadBytes = new byte[jsonPad];
for (int i = 0; i < jsonPad; i++) jsonPadBytes[i] = 0x20; // space
                bw.Write(jsonPadBytes);
                bw.Write(binaryChunkLen);
                bw.Write(new byte[] { 0x42, 0x49, 0x4E, 0x00 });
                bw.Write(binaryBuffer);
            }
        }
    }
}
