--- FILE: public/css/obs-family-editor.css ---
```css
﻿/* ============================================================
 * obs-family-editor.css
 * Modal family editor. Revit-like dark theme.
 * ============================================================ */

.obs-fe-backdrop {
  position: fixed; inset: 0; background: rgba(0,0,0,.55);
  z-index: 2147483600; display: none;
  align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  font: 12px/1.4 -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif;
  color: #d6dae2;
}
.obs-fe-backdrop.is-open { display: flex; }

.obs-fe-modal {
  width: 960px; max-width: 96vw;
  height: 640px; max-height: 92vh;
  background: #14171e;
  border: 1px solid #2a2f3a;
  border-radius: 8px;
  display: flex; flex-direction: column;
  box-shadow: 0 24px 64px rgba(0,0,0,.6);
  overflow: hidden;
}

.obs-fe-head {
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between;
  padding: 10px 14px;
  background: #1a1d24;
  border-bottom: 1px solid #2a2f3a;
}
.obs-fe-head h2 { margin: 0; font-size: 13px; color: #9cf; letter-spacing: .04em; text-transform: uppercase; }
.obs-fe-head .obs-fe-close {
  background: transparent; border: 0; color: #8892a0; font-size: 20px;
  cursor: pointer; padding: 0 6px; line-height: 1;
}
.obs-fe-head .obs-fe-close:hover { color: #fff; }

.obs-fe-body {
  flex: 1; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 320px;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.obs-fe-left  { padding: 12px 14px; overflow: auto; border-right: 1px solid #232830; }
.obs-fe-right { padding: 12px 14px; overflow: auto; background: #10131a; }

.obs-fe-section { margin-bottom: 18px; }
.obs-fe-section h3 {
  margin: 0 0 8px; font-size: 11px; color: #7f8a9a;
  letter-spacing: .1em; text-transform: uppercase; font-weight: 600;
}

.obs-fe-row { display: flex; gap: 8px; align-items: center; margin-bottom: 6px; }

.obs-fe-input, .obs-fe-select {
  background: #0b0d12; border: 1px solid #2a2f3a; color: #e6e8ee;
  padding: 5px 8px; border-radius: 4px; font-size: 12px; font-family: inherit;
  outline: none;
}
.obs-fe-input:focus, .obs-fe-select:focus { border-color: #2563eb; }
.obs-fe-input::placeholder { color: #4a5563; }

.obs-fe-btn {
  background: #2563eb; color: #fff; border: 0;
  padding: 6px 12px; border-radius: 4px; cursor: pointer;
  font-size: 12px; font-family: inherit;
}
.obs-fe-btn:hover { background: #1d4ed8; }
.obs-fe-btn.sec { background: #2a2f3a; }
.obs-fe-btn.sec:hover { background: #353b47; }
.obs-fe-btn.danger { background: #7f1d1d; }
.obs-fe-btn.danger:hover { background: #991b1b; }
.obs-fe-btn:disabled { opacity: .5; cursor: default; }

/* parameter table */
.obs-fe-table {
  width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 12px;
  background: #0b0d12; border-radius: 4px; overflow: hidden;
}
.obs-fe-table th {
  background: #1a1d24; color: #7f8a9a; font-weight: 600;
  padding: 6px 8px; text-align: left; font-size: 10px;
  text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .06em;
  border-bottom: 1px solid #232830;
}
.obs-fe-table td {
  padding: 4px 6px; border-bottom: 1px solid #1a1d24;
  vertical-align: middle;
}
.obs-fe-table tr:last-child td { border-bottom: 0; }
.obs-fe-table input, .obs-fe-table select {
  width: 100%; background: transparent; border: 0;
  color: inherit; font-size: 12px; font-family: inherit;
  outline: none; padding: 3px 4px;
}
.obs-fe-table input:focus, .obs-fe-table select:focus {
  background: #0b0d12; border-radius: 3px;
}
.obs-fe-table .col-del { width: 30px; }
.obs-fe-table .col-del button {
  background: transparent; border: 0; color: #8892a0;
  cursor: pointer; font-size: 14px; padding: 0 4px;
}
.obs-fe-table .col-del button:hover { color: #f87171; }
.obs-fe-table .col-kind { width: 100px; }
.obs-fe-table .col-scope { width: 72px; text-align: center; }
.obs-fe-table .col-formula { min-width: 180px; }
.obs-fe-table .formula-invalid { color: #f87171; }

/* constraint list */
.obs-fe-constraint {
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px;
  padding: 6px 8px; background: #0b0d12; border-radius: 4px;
  margin-bottom: 6px; font-size: 12px;
}
.obs-fe-constraint select { flex: 0 0 90px; }
.obs-fe-constraint .obs-fe-cons-target { flex: 1; min-width: 0; }
.obs-fe-constraint .obs-fe-cons-params { flex: 1; min-width: 0; }
.obs-fe-constraint button {
  background: transparent; border: 0; color: #8892a0; cursor: pointer;
}
.obs-fe-constraint button:hover { color: #f87171; }

/* status / preview */
.obs-fe-preview {
  background: #0b0d12; border: 1px solid #232830; border-radius: 4px;
  padding: 8px 10px; font-family: ui-monospace, Consolas, monospace;
  font-size: 11px; color: #9aa4b2; white-space: pre-wrap;
  max-height: 260px; overflow: auto;
}
.obs-fe-preview .k { color: #7f8a9a; }
.obs-fe-preview .v { color: #9cf; }
.obs-fe-preview .err { color: #f87171; }

.obs-fe-foot {
  display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center;
  padding: 10px 14px; background: #1a1d24;
  border-top: 1px solid #2a2f3a;
}
.obs-fe-foot .obs-fe-hint { color: #7f8a9a; font-size: 11px; }
.obs-fe-foot .obs-fe-actions { display: flex; gap: 8px; }

/* geometry recipe area */
.obs-fe-geo-badge {
  display: inline-block; padding: 3px 8px; border-radius: 12px;
  background: #1a1d24; color: #9cf; font-size: 11px;
  border: 1px solid #2a2f3a;
}
.obs-fe-geo-badge.empty { color: #7f8a9a; }

```
--- END FILE ---

--- FILE: public/css/obs-ribbon-arch.css ---
```css
﻿/* ============================================================
 * obs-ribbon-arch.css
 * Recreates the Architecture-tab ribbon look for any ribbon panel.
 * Add class "obs-ribbon-arch" to a <div> and use the markup below.
 * ============================================================ */

.obs-ribbon-arch {
  display: flex;
  align-items: stretch;
  height: 108px;
  background: #1a1d23;
  border-bottom: 1px solid #2a2f3a;
  padding: 4px 8px 0 8px;
  overflow-x: auto;
  font-family: -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif;
  color: #d6dae2;
  user-select: none;
}
.obs-ribbon-arch::-webkit-scrollbar { height: 6px; }
.obs-ribbon-arch::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb { background: #2f3644; border-radius: 3px; }

.obs-rb-group {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  justify-content: space-between;
  padding: 0 10px;
  position: relative;
  border-right: 1px solid #262b35;
  min-width: 60px;
}
.obs-rb-group:last-child { border-right: 0; }

.obs-rb-group-row {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  gap: 2px;
  padding-top: 2px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  max-height: 78px;
  align-content: flex-start;
}

.obs-rb-label {
  font-size: 9px;
  letter-spacing: .08em;
  color: #6b7280;
  text-align: center;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  padding: 2px 0 4px;
}

.obs-rb-btn {
  width: 62px;
  min-height: 36px;
  background: transparent;
  border: 1px solid transparent;
  border-radius: 3px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: flex-start;
  gap: 3px;
  padding: 4px 2px 2px;
  color: #cfd4dc;
  font-size: 10px;
  line-height: 1.15;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: background .08s, border-color .08s, color .08s;
}
.obs-rb-btn:hover { background: #22272f; border-color: #2f3644; color: #fff; }
.obs-rb-btn:active { background: #1a1f27; }
.obs-rb-btn.is-active { background: #2563eb; border-color: #2563eb; color: #fff; }
.obs-rb-btn:disabled { opacity: .35; cursor: default; }

.obs-rb-ico {
  width: 26px;
  height: 26px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  color: #a6b0be;
}
.obs-rb-btn:hover .obs-rb-ico,
.obs-rb-btn.is-active .obs-rb-ico { color: #fff; }
.obs-rb-ico svg { width: 22px; height: 22px; display: block; }

.obs-rb-name {
  font-size: 10px;
  text-align: center;
  white-space: normal;
  word-break: break-word;
  max-width: 60px;
}

/* For split buttons (like Level input under Architecture > Datum) */
.obs-rb-btn-wide {
  width: 62px;
  flex-direction: column;
}
.obs-rb-btn-wide .obs-rb-name { font-weight: 500; }

.obs-rb-input {
  width: 46px;
  background: #0b0d12;
  border: 1px solid #2f3644;
  color: #e6e8ee;
  font-size: 11px;
  padding: 1px 3px;
  border-radius: 3px;
  text-align: center;
}
```

--- FILE: public/js/autodesk-import.js ---
```js
﻿/* ============================================================================
 *  OpenBIMstudio - Autodesk Viewer Importer  (no APS credentials required)
 *  --------------------------------------------------------------------------
 *  Adds a floating "Import from Autodesk" button. Clicking it opens a modal:
 *
 *    Step 1 - Open the Autodesk Viewer tab (paste URL + "Open viewer")
 *    Step 2 - Click "Copy properties script" or "Copy geometry script",
 *             paste into the viewer's DevTools console, press Enter.
 *             A .json or .glb file downloads.
 *    Step 3 - Drop that file onto the drop-zone in the modal.
 *
 *  The button never talks to APS itself - extraction runs inside the
 *  Autodesk viewer using its public JavaScript API.
 * ============================================================================ */
(function () {
  'use strict';

  var BTN_ID   = 'obim-autodesk-btn';
  var MODAL_ID = 'obim-autodesk-modal';

  /* -------------------------------------------------------------- snippets */

  var SCRIPT_PROPERTIES = [
    "(async function(){",
    "  var v = window.NOP_VIEWER || (window.Autodesk && Autodesk.Viewing && Autodesk.Viewing.NOP_VIEWER) || null;",
    "  if(!v || !v.model){ return console.error('[OpenBIMstudio] No Autodesk viewer / model on this page.'); }",
    "  var model = v.model;",
    
"  var it = model.getInstanceTree ? model.getInstanceTree() : model.getObjectTree();",
    "  var dbIds = [];",
    "  if (it && typeof it.enumNodeChildren === 'function') { it.enumNodeChildren(it.getRootId(), function(id){ dbIds.push(id); }, true); }",
    "  else if (it && typeof it.getAllObjects === 'function') { dbIds = it.getAllObjects(); }",
    "  else { return console.error('[OpenBIMstudio] Viewer does not expose a usable instance tree.'); }"
,
    "  console.log('[OpenBIMstudio] Reading', dbIds.length, 'objects...');",
    "  var elements = await new Promise(function(res, rej){",
    "    model.getBulkProperties(dbIds, null, res, rej);",
    "  });",
    "  var extMap = await new Promise(function(res){",
    "    try { model.getExternalIdMapping(res, function(){ res({}); }); } catch(e){ res({}); }",
    "  });",
    "  var data = (model.getData && model.getData()) || {};",
    "  var payload = {",
    "    source: 'autodesk-viewer',",
    "    path: 'A-properties',",
    "    exportedAt: new Date().toISOString(),",
    "    urn: data.urn || null,",
    "    documentId: data.documentId || data.parentDocumentId || null,",
    "    elements: elements.map(function(e){",
    "      return {",
    "        dbId: e.dbId,",
    "        externalId: (extMap && extMap[e.dbId]) || e.externalId || null,",
    "        name: e.name,",
    "        properties: e.properties",
    "      };",
    "    })",
    "  };",
    "  var blob = new Blob([JSON.stringify(payload, null, 2)], {type:'application/json'});",
    "  var url  = URL.createObjectURL(blob);",
    "  var a    = document.createElement('a');",
    "  a.href = url; a.download = 'autodesk-properties.json';",
    "  document.body.appendChild(a); a.click();",
    "  setTimeout(function(){ URL.revokeObjectURL(url); a.remove(); }, 1000);",
    "  console.log('[OpenBIMstudio] Saved autodesk-properties.json (' + elements.length + ' objects)');",
    "})().catch(function(e){ console.error(e); });"
  ].join("\n");

  var SCRIPT_GEOMETRY = [
    "(async function(){",
    "  var v = window.NOP_VIEWER || (window.Autodesk && Autodesk.Viewing && Autodesk.Viewing.NOP_VIEWER) || null;",
    "  if(!v || !v.model){ return console.error('[OpenBIMstudio] No Autodesk viewer / model on this page.'); }",
    "  var names = ['Autodesk.Viewing.GeometryExporterExtension','GeometryExporterExtension'];",
    "  var ext = null;",
    "  for (var i=0;i<names.length;i++){",
    "    try { ext = await v.loadExtension(names[i]); if(ext) break; } catch(e){ /* try next */ }",
    "  }",
    "  if(!ext){",
    "    return console.error('[OpenBIMstudio] GeometryExporter not available. Before the viewer is initialised, run: Autodesk.Viewing.FeatureFlags.set(Autodesk.Viewing.PublicFeatureFlags.SceneAPI, true);');",
    "  }",
    "  try {",
    "    if(typeof ext.download === 'function'){",
    "      await ext.download({ format: 'glb', filename: 'autodesk-scene.glb' });",
    "    } else if(typeof ext.export === 'function'){",
    "      await ext.export('glb', 'autodesk-scene.glb');",
    "    } else {",
    "      throw new Error('GeometryExporter has no download/export method.');",
    "    }",
    "    console.log('[OpenBIMstudio] Saved autodesk-scene.glb');",
    "  } catch(e){",
    "    console.error('[OpenBIMstudio] Geometry export failed:', e);",
    "  }",
    "})().catch(function(e){ console.error(e); });"
  ].join("\n");

  /* ---------------------------------------------------------------- styles */

  function injectStyles() {
    if (document.getElementById('obim-autodesk-style')) return;
    var s = document.createElement('style');
    s.id = 'obim-autodesk-style';
    s.textContent = [
      '#' + BTN_ID + '{position:fixed;left:20px;bottom:20px;z-index:2147483200;',
      'padding:12px 18px;border-radius:24px;border:none;cursor:pointer;',
      'font:600 14px/1.2 system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",Roboto,sans-serif;',
      'color:#fff;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#0a84ff,#0066cc);',
      'box-shadow:0 6px 18px rgba(0,102,204,.35);',
      'transition:transform .15s ease,box-shadow .15s ease;}',
      '#' + BTN_ID + ':hover{transform:translateY(-2px);',
      'box-shadow:0 10px 24px rgba(0,102,204,.45);}',
      '#' + MODAL_ID + '{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:2147483640;display:none;',
      'align-items:center;justify-content:center;background:rgba(0,0,0,.45);',
      'backdrop-filter:blur(3px);',
      'font:14px/1.45 system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",Roboto,sans-serif;}',
      '#' + MODAL_ID + '.open{display:flex;}',
      '#' + MODAL_ID + ' .obim-card{width:min(640px,94vw);max-height:92vh;',
      'overflow:auto;background:#fff;border-radius:14px;padding:22px 22px 18px;',
      'box-shadow:0 24px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.25);}',
      '#' + MODAL_ID + ' h3{margin:0 0 6px;font-size:18px;}',
      '#' + MODAL_ID + ' h4{margin:14px 0 6px;font-size:14px;}',
      '#' + MODAL_ID + ' p.hint{margin:0 0 10px;color:#666;font-size:12.5px;}',
      '#' + MODAL_ID + ' label{display:block;font-weight:600;margin:10px 0 4px;',
      'font-size:12.5px;}',
      '#' + MODAL_ID + ' input{width:100%;box-sizing:border-box;padding:10px 12px;',
      'border:1px solid #d0d5dd;border-radius:8px;font:inherit;outline:none;}',
      '#' + MODAL_ID + ' input:focus{border-color:#0a84ff;',
      'box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(10,132,255,.15);}',
      '#' + MODAL_ID + ' .obim-row{display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:6px;}',
      '#' + MODAL_ID + ' button{padding:9px 14px;border-radius:8px;',
      'border:1px solid transparent;font:600 13px/1 inherit;cursor:pointer;}',
      '#' + MODAL_ID + ' button.primary{background:#0a84ff;color:#fff;}',
      '#' + MODAL_ID + ' button.ghost{background:#fff;color:#333;',
      'border-color:#d0d5dd;}',
      '#' + MODAL_ID + ' .obim-drop{margin-top:10px;border:2px dashed #c8d2e0;',
      'border-radius:10px;padding:22px 14px;text-align:center;color:#5b6b82;',
      'font-size:13px;background:#f8fafc;transition:border-color .15s,background .15s;}',
      '#' + MODAL_ID + ' .obim-drop.hover{border-color:#0a84ff;background:#eef6ff;',
      'color:#0a84ff;}',
      '#' + MODAL_ID + ' .obim-status{margin-top:10px;font-size:12.5px;',
      'min-height:16px;color:#555;}',
      '#' + MODAL_ID + ' .obim-status.err{color:#c0392b;}',
      '#' + MODAL_ID + ' .obim-status.ok{color:#1e8e3e;}',
      '#' + MODAL_ID + ' .obim-actions{display:flex;gap:10px;justify-content:flex-end;',
      'margin-top:16px;}'
    ].join('');
    document.head.appendChild(s);
  }

  /* ---------------------------------------------------------------- helpers */

  function copyText(text, btn) {
    var done = function () {
      if (!btn) return;
      var old = btn.textContent;
      btn.textContent = 'Copied!';
      setTimeout(function () { btn.textContent = old; }, 1200);
    };
    if (navigator.clipboard && navigator.clipboard.writeText) {
      navigator.clipboard.writeText(text).then(done, function () { legacyCopy(text, done); });
    } else {
      legacyCopy(text, done);
    }
  }
  function legacyCopy(text, done) {
    var ta = document.createElement('textarea');
    ta.value = text;
    ta.style.position = 'fixed';
    ta.style.opacity = '0';
    document.body.appendChild(ta);
    ta.select();
    try { document.execCommand('copy'); done && done(); } catch (e) {}
    ta.remove();
  }

  function kindOf(name, mime) {
    name = (name || '').toLowerCase();
    mime = (mime || '').toLowerCase();
    if (name.slice(-4) === '.ifc' || mime.indexOf('ifc') !== -1) return 'ifc';
    if (name.slice(-4) === '.glb' || name.slice(-5) === '.gltf') return 'glb';
    if (name.slice(-5) === '.json') return 'json';
    return 'unknown';
  }

  function dispatch(kind, file, parsed) {
    var hooks = {
      ifc: [
        ['OpenBIMStudio.loadIfcFile', function () { return window.OpenBIMStudio && window.OpenBIMStudio.loadIfcFile && window.OpenBIMStudio.loadIfcFile(file); }],
        ['loadIfcFile',              function () { return window.loadIfcFile && window.loadIfcFile(file); }],
        ['loadIfc',                  function () { return window.loadIfc && window.loadIfc(file); }],
        ['ifcLoader.load',           function () { return window.ifcLoader && window.ifcLoader.load && window.ifcLoader.load(file, true); }],
        ['viewer.IFC.loadIfcFile',   function () { return window.viewer && window.viewer.IFC && window.viewer.IFC.loadIfcFile && window.viewer.IFC.loadIfcFile(file); }]
      ],
      glb: [
        ['OpenBIMStudio.loadGLB',    function () { return window.OpenBIMStudio && window.OpenBIMStudio.loadGLB && window.OpenBIMStudio.loadGLB(file); }],
        ['loadGLB',                  function () { return window.loadGLB && window.loadGLB(file); }],
        ['loadGLTF',                 function () { return window.loadGLTF && window.loadGLTF(file); }],
        ['viewer.loadGLTF',          function () { return window.viewer && window.viewer.loadGLTF && window.viewer.loadGLTF(file); }]
      ],
      json: [
        ['OpenBIMStudio.loadProperties', function () { return window.OpenBIMStudio && window.OpenBIMStudio.loadProperties && window.OpenBIMStudio.loadProperties(parsed); }],
        ['loadProperties',               function () { return window.loadProperties && window.loadProperties(parsed); }]
      ]
    };
    var list = hooks[kind] || [];
    for (var i = 0; i < list.length; i++) {
      try {
        var r = list[i][1]();
        if (r !== undefined && r !== false) {
          console.info('[OpenBIMStudio] handed to ' + list[i][0] + '()');
          return true;
        }
      } catch (e) {
        console.warn('hook ' + list[i][0] + ' failed:', e);
      }
    }
    var evName = kind === 'ifc'  ? 'openbimstudio:load-ifc'
               : kind === 'glb'  ? 'openbimstudio:load-glb'
               : kind === 'json' ? 'openbimstudio:load-properties'
               : 'openbimstudio:load-file';
    window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent(evName, {
      detail: { file: file, parsed: parsed, kind: kind }
    }));
    console.warn('[OpenBIMStudio] No built-in hook for "' + kind + '"; dispatched "' + evName + '".');
    return false;
  }

  function handleFile(file, statusEl) {
    var kind = kindOf(file.name, file.type);
    statusEl.className = 'obim-status';
    statusEl.textContent = 'Received ' + file.name + ' (' + kind + ') - processing...';

    if (kind === 'json') {
      file.text().then(function (txt) {
        var parsed = null;
        try { parsed = JSON.parse(txt); }
        catch (e) {
          statusEl.className = 'obim-status err';
          statusEl.textContent = 'Invalid JSON: ' + e.message;
          return;
        }
        var ok = dispatch(kind, file, parsed);
        statusEl.className = 'obim-status ' + (ok ? 'ok' : '');
        statusEl.textContent = ok ? 'Properties imported.'
                                  : 'Dispatched openbimstudio:load-properties (bind it in your app).';
      });
      return;
    }
    var ok = dispatch(kind, file, null);
    statusEl.className = 'obim-status ' + (ok ? 'ok' : '');
    statusEl.textContent = ok ? 'Imported.'
                              : 'Dispatched ' + kind + ' event - bind it in your app to handle the file.';
  }

  /* ----------------------------------------------------------------- modal */

  function buildModal() {
    if (document.getElementById(MODAL_ID)) return;

    var m = document.createElement('div');
    m.id = MODAL_ID;
    m.innerHTML =
      '<div class="obim-card" role="dialog" aria-modal="true">' +
      '  <h3>Import from Autodesk Viewer</h3>' +
      '  <p class="hint">No APS credentials required. Extraction runs inside the Autodesk viewer tab using its JavaScript API.</p>' +

      '  <h4>Step 1 &mdash; Open the Autodesk Viewer</h4>' +
      '  <label for="obim-link">Viewer URL (optional, for convenience)</label>' +
      '  <input id="obim-link" type="text" placeholder="https://viewer.autodesk.com/..."/>' +
      '  <div class="obim-row">' +
      '    <button class="ghost" id="obim-open">Open viewer in new tab</button>' +
      '  </div>' +

      '  <h4>Step 2 &mdash; Copy an extraction script</h4>' +
      '  <p class="hint">In the viewer tab open DevTools (F12) &rarr; Console, paste the script, press Enter. A file will download.</p>' +
      '  <div class="obim-row">' +
      '    <button class="primary" id="obim-copy-props">Copy properties script (.json)</button>' +
      '    <button class="primary" id="obim-copy-geom">Copy geometry script (.glb)</button>' +
      '  </div>' +

      '  <h4>Step 3 &mdash; Drop the downloaded file here</h4>' +
      '  <div class="obim-drop" id="obim-drop">' +
      '    Drop <b>.json</b> (properties) or <b>.glb</b>/<b>.gltf</b> (geometry) here &mdash; or click to browse' +
      '    <input id="obim-file" type="file" accept=".json,.glb,.gltf,.ifc" style="display:none"/>' +
      '  </div>' +

      '  <div class="obim-status" id="obim-status"></div>' +
      '  <div class="obim-actions">' +
      '    <button class="ghost" id="obim-close">Close</button>' +
      '  </div>' +
      '</div>';
    document.body.appendChild(m);

    m.addEventListener('click', function (e) { if (e.target === m) m.classList.remove('open'); });
    m.querySelector('#obim-close').addEventListener('click', function () { m.classList.remove('open'); });

    m.querySelector('#obim-open').addEventListener('click', function () {
      var url = m.querySelector('#obim-link').value.trim() || 'https://viewer.autodesk.com/';
      window.open(url, '_blank', 'noopener');
    });
    m.querySelector('#obim-copy-props').addEventListener('click', function (e) { copyText(SCRIPT_PROPERTIES, e.currentTarget); });
    m.querySelector('#obim-copy-geom').addEventListener('click',  function (e) { copyText(SCRIPT_GEOMETRY,  e.currentTarget); });

    var drop      = m.querySelector('#obim-drop');
    var fileInput = m.querySelector('#obim-file');
    var status    = m.querySelector('#obim-status');

    drop.addEventListener('click', function () { fileInput.click(); });
    fileInput.addEventListener('change', function () {
      if (fileInput.files && fileInput.files[0]) handleFile(fileInput.files[0], status);
    });
    ['dragenter','dragover'].forEach(function (ev) {
      drop.addEventListener(ev, function (e) { e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation(); drop.classList.add('hover'); });
    });
    ['dragleave','drop'].forEach(function (ev) {
      drop.addEventListener(ev, function (e) { e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation(); drop.classList.remove('hover'); });
    });
    drop.addEventListener('drop', function (e) {
      var dt = e.dataTransfer;
      if (dt && dt.files && dt.files[0]) handleFile(dt.files[0], status);
    });
  }

  /* ---------------------------------------------------------------- button */

  function buildButton() {
    if (document.getElementById(BTN_ID)) return;
    var b = document.createElement('button');
    b.id = BTN_ID;
    b.type = 'button';
    b.textContent = 'Import from Autodesk';
    b.title = 'Import properties or geometry from an Autodesk Viewer session';
    b.addEventListener('click', function () {
      buildModal();
      document.getElementById(MODAL_ID).classList.add('open');
    });
    document.body.appendChild(b);
  }

  function boot() {
    injectStyles();
    buildButton();
    console.info('[OpenBIMStudio] Autodesk importer ready (viewer-side, no APS).');
  }

  if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', boot);
  } else {
    boot();
  }
})();
```

```js
(function () {

      + '</div>';
    document.body.appendChild(host);
    modal = host.querySelector('.obs-fe-modal');

    host.querySelector('.obs-fe-close').onclick = close;
    host.querySelector('#fe-close').onclick = close;
    host.addEventListener('mousedown', function (e) { if (e.target === host) close(); });

    document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
      if (!isOpen()) return;
      if (e.key === 'Escape') close();
      if (e.ctrlKey && (e.key === 's' || e.key === 'S')) { e.preventDefault(); saveToLibrary(); }
    });

    host.querySelector('#fe-name').addEventListener('input', function (e) {
      state.family.name = e.target.value || 'NewFamily';
      renderPreview();
    });
    host.querySelector('#fe-cat').addEventListener('change', function (e) {
      state.family.category = e.target.value;
    });

    host.querySelector('#fe-add-param').onclick = function () {
      state.family.parameters.push({ name: 'Param' + (state.family.parameters.length + 1),
                                     kind: 'Number', isType: true, default: 0, formula: '' });
      renderParameters(); renderPreview();
    };

    host.querySelector('#fe-add-cons').onclick = function () {
      state.family.constraints.push({ kind: 'range', target: ['Width'], params: { min: 0.1, max: 10 } });
      renderConstraints(); renderPreview();
    };

    Array.prototype.forEach.call(host.querySelectorAll('[data-geo]'), function (b) {
      b.onclick = function () { setGeoKind(b.dataset.geo); };
    });

    host.querySelector('#fe-test').onclick = testInScene;
    host.querySelector('#fe-save-lib').onclick = saveToLibrary;
    host.querySelector('#fe-download').onclick = downloadJson;
    host.querySelector('#fe-upload').onclick = uploadJson;

    var libSel = host.querySelector('#fe-lib');
    libSel.onchange = function () {
      if (!libSel.value) return;
      var lib = loadLibrary();
      if (lib[libSel.value]) {
        state.family = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(lib[libSel.value]));
        refreshAll();
        renderPreview();
      }
    };
  }

  function isOpen() { return host && host.classList.contains('is-open'); }
  function open() { buildDom(); renderLibrarySelect(); refreshAll(); renderPreview(); host.classList.add('is-open'); }
  function close() { if (host) host.classList.remove('is-open'); }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- render
  function refreshAll() {
    host.querySelector('#fe-name').value = state.family.name;
    host.querySelector('#fe-cat').value = state.family.category;
    renderParameters();
    renderConstraints();
    renderGeoBadge();
  }

  function renderParameters() {
    var tbody = host.querySelector('#fe-params tbody');
    tbody.innerHTML = '';
    var paramNames = state.family.parameters.map(function (p) { return p.name; });

    state.family.parameters.forEach(function (p, i) {
      var tr = document.createElement('tr');

      // name
      var tdName = document.createElement('td');
      var inName = document.createElement('input');
      inName.value = p.name;
      inName.oninput = function () {
        p.name = inName.value;
        renderPreview();
      };
      tdName.appendChild(inName);
      tr.appendChild(tdName);

      // kind
      var tdKind = document.createElement('td');
      var selKind = document.createElement('select');
      ['Length','Area','Volume','Angle','Number','Integer','Text','YesNo'].forEach(function (k) {
        var o = document.createElement('option'); o.value = k; o.textContent = k;
        if (p.kind === k) o.selected = true;
        selKind.appendChild(o);
      });
      selKind.onchange = function () { p.kind = selKind.value; renderPreview(); };
      tdKind.appendChild(selKind);
      tr.appendChild(tdKind);

      // scope
      var tdScope = document.createElement('td');
      tdScope.className = 'col-scope';
      var selScope = document.createElement('select');
      [['Type', true], ['Instance', false]].forEach(function (pair) {
        var o = document.createElement('option'); o.value = String(pair[1]); o.textContent = pair[0];
        if (p.isType === pair[1]) o.selected = true;
        selScope.appendChild(o);
      });
      selScope.onchange = function () { p.isType = (selScope.value === 'true'); };
      tdScope.appendChild(selScope);
      tr.appendChild(tdScope);

      // default
      var tdDef = document.createElement('td');
      var inDef = document.createElement('input');
      inDef.value = p.default == null ? '' : p.default;
      inDef.oninput = function () {
        var v = inDef.value;
        p.default = (p.kind === 'Text' || p.kind === 'Material' || p.kind === 'URL') ? v : Number(v);
        if (isNaN(p.default)) p.default = 0;
        renderPreview();
      };
      tdDef.appendChild(inDef);
      tr.appendChild(tdDef);

      // formula
      var tdForm = document.createElement('td');
      tdForm.className = 'col-formula';
      var inForm = document.createElement('input');
      inForm.value = p.formula || '';
      inForm.placeholder = p.name ? 'e.g. Width * 2' : '';
      inForm.oninput = function () {
        p.formula = inForm.value.trim();
        validateFormula(p, inForm);
        renderPreview();
      };
      tdForm.appendChild(inForm);
      tr.appendChild(tdForm);

      // delete
      var tdDel = document.createElement('td');
      tdDel.className = 'col-del';
      var btnDel = document.createElement('button');
      btnDel.innerHTML = '&times;';
      btnDel.title = 'Delete parameter';
      btnDel.onclick = function () {
        state.family.parameters.splice(i, 1);
        renderParameters(); renderPreview();
      };
      tdDel.appendChild(btnDel);
      tr.appendChild(tdDel);

      tbody.appendChild(tr);

      validateFormula(p, inForm);
    });
  }

  function validateFormula(p, inputEl) {
    inputEl.classList.remove('formula-invalid');
    if (!p.formula) return;
    try {
      var RE = window.RevitParametricEngine;
      if (!RE || !RE.FormulaEngine) return;
      var ctx = {};
      state.family.parameters.forEach(function (q) { ctx[q.name] = 1; });
      ctx[p.name] = 1;
      RE.FormulaEngine.evaluate(p.formula, ctx);
    } catch (e) {
      inputEl.classList.add('formula-invalid');
      inputEl.title = e.message;
    }
  }

  function renderConstraints() {
    var hostEl = host.querySelector('#fe-constraints');
    hostEl.innerHTML = '';
    if (!state.family.constraints.length) {
      hostEl.innerHTML = '<div style="color:#7f8a9a;font-size:11px;padding:4px 0">No constraints</div>';
      return;
    }
    state.family.constraints.forEach(function (c, i) {
      var div = document.createElement('div');
      div.className = 'obs-fe-constraint';

      var selKind = document.createElement('select');
      ['equal','ratio','lock','sum','range'].forEach(function (k) {
        var o = document.createElement('option'); o.value = k; o.textContent = k;
        if (c.kind === k) o.selected = true;
        selKind.appendChild(o);
      });
      selKind.onchange = function () {
        c.kind = selKind.value;
        c.params = defaultConsParams(c.kind);
        renderConstraints(); renderPreview();
      };
      div.appendChild(selKind);

      var inTarget = document.createElement('input');
      inTarget.className = 'obs-fe-cons-target';
      inTarget.value = (c.target || []).join(',');
      inTarget.placeholder = 'Width,Height';
      inTarget.oninput = function () {
        c.target = inTarget.value.split(',').map(function (s) { return s.trim(); }).filter(Boolean);
        renderPreview();
      };
      div.appendChild(inTarget);

      var inParams = document.createElement('input');
      inParams.className = 'obs-fe-cons-params';
      inParams.value = JSON.stringify(c.params || {});
      inParams.placeholder = '{"factor":2}';
      inParams.oninput = function () {
        try { c.params = JSON.parse(inParams.value || '{}'); inParams.style.color = ''; }
        catch (e) { inParams.style.color = '#f87171'; }
        renderPreview();
      };
      div.appendChild(inParams);

      var btnDel = document.createElement('button');
      btnDel.innerHTML = '&times;';
      btnDel.onclick = function () {
        state.family.constraints.splice(i, 1);
        renderConstraints(); renderPreview();
      };
      div.appendChild(btnDel);

      hostEl.appendChild(div);
    });
  }

  function defaultConsParams(kind) {
    switch (kind) {
      case 'ratio': return { factor: 1 };
      case 'lock':  return { value: 0 };
      case 'sum':   return { value: 0 };
      case 'range': return { min: 0, max: 10 };
      default:      return {};
    }
  }

  function renderGeoBadge() {
    var hostEl = host.querySelector('#fe-geo');
    var g = state.family.geometry;
    if (!g) { hostEl.innerHTML = '<span class="obs-fe-geo-badge empty">not set</span>'; return; }
    hostEl.innerHTML = '<span class="obs-fe-geo-badge">' + g.kind + '</span>';
  }

  function setGeoKind(kind) {
    if (kind === 'Extrusion') {
      state.family.geometry = {
        kind: 'Extrusion',
        profile: { kind: 'Rectangle', width: state.family.parameters[0] ? state.family.parameters[0].name : '1', height: state.family.parameters[1] ? state.family.parameters[1].name : '1' },
        depth: state.family.parameters[2] ? state.family.parameters[2].name : '0.2',
        origin: { x: 0, y: 0, z: 0 }
      };
    } else if (kind === 'Revolve') {
      state.family.geometry = {
        kind: 'Revolve',
        profile: { kind: 'Rectangle', width: 'Width', height: '0.1' },
        axis: { origin: { x: 0, y: 0, z: 0 }, dir: { x: 0, y: 1, z: 0 } },
        angle: '6.283'
      };
    } else if (kind === 'Sweep') {
      state.family.geometry = {
        kind: 'Sweep',
        profile: { kind: 'Circle', radius: '0.1' },
        path: { kind: 'Polygon', points: [{ x: 0, y: 0 }, { x: 'Width', y: 0 }] }
      };
    }
    renderGeoBadge(); renderPreview();
  }

  function renderPreview() {
    var hostEl = host.querySelector('#fe-preview');
    var RE = window.RevitParametricEngine;
    if (!RE) { hostEl.innerHTML = '<span class="err">RevitParametricEngine not loaded</span>'; return; }

    var engine = null;
    try {
      var p = window.OpenBIMStudio && window.OpenBIMStudio.parametric;
      engine = p && p.getEngine ? p.getEngine() : null;
    } catch (e) {}

    if (!engine) {
      hostEl.innerHTML = '<span class="err">No engine attached. Load an IFC first or click "Test in scene".</span>';
      return;
    }

    try {
      // Snapshot current families map, insert temp family, resolve, revert
      var famName = '__obs_preview__';
      var tmpEngine = new RE.RevitParametricEngine(null, 0, { autoRegen: false });
      var spec = {
        category: state.family.category,
        parameters: state.family.parameters.map(function (p) {
          return { name: p.name, kind: p.kind, isType: p.isType, default: p.default };
        }),
        formulas: state.family.parameters.filter(function (p) { return p.formula; })
                                          .map(function (p) { return p.name + ' = ' + p.formula; }),
        constraints: state.family.constraints.map(function (c) {
          return new RE.Constraint(c.kind, c.target, c.params);
        }),
        geometry: function () { return state.family.geometry; }
      };
      tmpEngine.defineFamily(famName, spec);
      tmpEngine.defineType(famName, 'Default');
      tmpEngine.bindInstance(1, famName, 'Default');

      var ctx = tmpEngine.effectiveParameters(1);
      var diff = tmpEngine.regenerate();

      var lines = [];
      Object.keys(ctx).forEach(function (k) {
        lines.push('<span class="k">' + k + '</span>: <span class="v">' + ctx[k] + '</span>');
      });
      if (diff[0] && diff[0].geometry) {
        lines.push('');
        lines.push('<span class="k">geometry</span>: <span class="v">' + diff[0].geometry.kind + '</span>');
      }
      hostEl.innerHTML = lines.join('\n');
    } catch (e) {
      hostEl.innerHTML = '<span class="err">' + e.message + '</span>';
    }
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- actions
  function testInScene() {
    var RE = window.RevitParametricEngine;
    if (!RE) { alert('RevitParametricEngine not loaded'); return; }
    var engine = null;
    try {
      var p = window.OpenBIMStudio && window.OpenBIMStudio.parametric;
      engine = p && p.getEngine ? p.getEngine() : null;
    } catch (e) {}
    if (!engine) { alert('No engine attached. Load an IFC first.'); return; }

    var famName = state.family.name || 'TestFamily';
    var spec = {
      category: state.family.category,
      parameters: state.family.parameters.map(function (p) {
        return { name: p.name, kind: p.kind, isType: p.isType, default: p.default };
      }),
      formulas: state.family.parameters.filter(function (p) { return p.formula; })
                                        .map(function (p) { return p.name + ' = ' + p.formula; }),
      constraints: state.family.constraints.map(function (c) {
        return new RE.Constraint(c.kind, c.target, c.params);
      }),
      geometry: function () { return state.family.geometry; }
    };

    engine.defineFamily(famName, spec);
    engine.defineType(famName, 'Default');
    var fakeID = Math.floor(Math.random() * 900000) + 100000;
    engine.bindInstance(fakeID, famName, 'Default');
    var diff = engine.regenerate();
    console.info('[OBS-family-editor] test placed instance', fakeID, diff);
    alert('Test placed instance #' + fakeID + ' using family "' + famName + '".');
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- library
  function loadLibrary() {
    try { return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(LS_KEY) || '{}'); } catch (e) { return {}; }
  }
  function saveLibrary(lib) {
    localStorage.setItem(LS_KEY, JSON.stringify(lib));
  }
  function saveToLibrary() {
    var lib = loadLibrary();
    lib[state.family.name] = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(state.family));
    saveLibrary(lib);
    renderLibrarySelect();
    console.info('[OBS-family-editor] saved to library:', state.family.name);
  }
  function renderLibrarySelect() {
    var sel = host.querySelector('#fe-lib');
    var lib = loadLibrary();
    sel.innerHTML = '<option value="">-- load --</option>';
    Object.keys(lib).sort().forEach(function (k) {
      var o = document.createElement('option'); o.value = k; o.textContent = k;
      sel.appendChild(o);
    });
  }

  function downloadJson() {
    var blob = new Blob([JSON.stringify(state.family, null, 2)], { type: 'application/json' });
    var a = document.createElement('a');
    a.href = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    a.download = (state.family.name || 'family') + '.json';
    a.click();
    setTimeout(function () { URL.revokeObjectURL(a.href); }, 500);
  }
  function uploadJson() {
    var input = document.createElement('input');
    input.type = 'file'; input.accept = '.json,application/json';
    input.onchange = function () {
      var f = input.files[0]; if (!f) return;
      var r = new FileReader();
      r.onload = function () {
        try {
          state.family = JSON.parse(r.result);
          refreshAll(); renderPreview();
        } catch (e) { alert('Invalid JSON: ' + e.message); }
      };
      r.readAsText(f);
    };
    input.click();
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- ribbon wiring
  window.addEventListener('obs:param-ribbon-command', function (e) {
    var cmd = e.detail && e.detail.command;
    switch (cmd) {
      case 'fam-new':   state.family = blankFamily(); open(); break;
      case 'fam-load':  open(); host.querySelector('#fe-lib').focus(); break;
      case 'fam-edit':  open(); break;
      case 'fam-types': open(); break;

      case 'prm-add':   open(); host.querySelector('#fe-add-param').click(); break;
      case 'prm-form':  open(); {
        var inputs = host.querySelectorAll('#fe-params .col-formula input');
        if (inputs.length) inputs[inputs.length - 1].focus();
      } break;
      case 'prm-cnst':  open(); host.querySelector('#fe-add-cons').click(); break;
      case 'prm-grp':   open(); break;

      case 'geo-ext':   open(); setGeoKind('Extrusion'); break;
      case 'geo-rev':   open(); setGeoKind('Revolve');   break;
      case 'geo-swp':   open(); setGeoKind('Sweep');     break;
      case 'geo-bln':   open(); setGeoKind('Extrusion'); break;
      case 'geo-boo':   open(); break;

      case 'anl-regen': {
        var eng = window.OpenBIMStudio?.parametric?.getEngine?.();
        if (eng) { var d = eng.regenerate(); console.info('[OBS-family-editor] regen', d); }
      } break;
      case 'anl-diff': {
        var eng2 = window.OpenBIMStudio?.parametric?.getEngine?.();
        if (eng2) { console.table(eng2.regenerate({ dryRun: true })); }
      } break;
      case 'anl-save': {
        var eng3 = window.OpenBIMStudio?.parametric?.getEngine?.();
        if (eng3 && eng3.downloadIFC) eng3.downloadIFC('parametric.ifc');
      } break;

      case 'lib-samp': open(); saveToLibrary(); break;
      case 'lib-tmpl': open(); renderLibrarySelect(); break;
    }
  });

  // public handle
  window.OBSFamilyEditor = {
    open: open,
    close: close,
    getState: function () { return state; },
    load: function (family) { state.family = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(family)); open(); }
  };

  console.info('[OBS-family-editor] ready. Ribbon commands wired.');
})();
```

```js
﻿/* ============================================================
 * obs-parametric-ribbon.js
 * On DOM ready, finds the Parametric ribbon container and replaces
 * its inner content with an Architecture-styled grouped ribbon.
 *
 * Detection is tolerant: it looks for the tab button whose text is
 * exactly "Parametric", then scans for the sibling panel it controls.
 * ============================================================ */
(function () {
  'use strict';
  if (window.__OBS_PARAM_RIBBON__) return;
  window.__OBS_PARAM_RIBBON__ = true;

  // ---------- SVG icons (22x22, stroke-based, matches Arch look) ----------
  var I = {
    family:  '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6"><path d="M3 10l9-6 9 6v10H3z"/><path d="M9 20v-6h6v6"/></svg>',
    load:    '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6"><path d="M12 3v12"/><path d="M7 10l5 5 5-5"/><path d="M4 19h16"/></svg>',
    edit:    '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6"><path d="M4 20h4l10-10-4-4L4 16z"/><path d="M14 6l4 4"/></svg>',
    types:   '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6"><rect x="3" y="4" width="18" height="4"/><rect x="3" y="10" width="18" height="4"/><rect x="3" y="16" width="18" height="4"/></svg>',

    param:   '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6"><path d="M4 12h16"/><circle cx="8" cy="12" r="3"/><circle cx="16" cy="12" r="3"/></svg>',
    formula: '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6"><path d="M5 5h6l-6 14h6"/><path d="M14 8h5"/><path d="M14 16h5"/><path d="M16.5 8v8"/></svg>',
    constrain:'<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6"><path d="M4 6h16"/><path d="M4 18h16"/><path d="M8 6v12"/><path d="M16 6v12"/></svg>',
    group:   '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6"><rect x="4" y="4" width="7" height="7"/><rect x="13" y="4" width="7" height="7"/><rect x="4" y="13" width="7" height="7"/><rect x="13" y="13" width="7" height="7"/></svg>',

    extrude: '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6"><rect x="6" y="6" width="8" height="8"/><path d="M10 10l6 6"/><path d="M18 4v6"/><path d="M18 4l3 3"/><path d="M18 4l-3 3"/></svg>',
    revolve: '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6"><ellipse cx="12" cy="12" rx="6" ry="8"/><path d="M4 12h16"/></svg>',
    sweep:   '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6"><path d="M4 18c4-2 8-10 16-12"/><circle cx="6" cy="18" r="2"/><circle cx="18" cy="6" r="2"/></svg>',
    blend:   '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6"><path d="M6 4h12l-4 16H10z"/></svg>',
    boolean: '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6"><circle cx="10" cy="12" r="6"/><circle cx="14" cy="12" r="6"/></svg>',

    regen:   '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6"><path d="M4 12a8 8 0 1 1 3 6"/><path d="M4 18v-4h4"/></svg>',
    diff:    '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6"><rect x="3" y="5" width="8" height="14"/><rect x="13" y="5" width="8" height="14"/><path d="M9 9h6"/><path d="M9 15h6"/></svg>',
    persist: '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6"><path d="M5 4h11l3 3v13H5z"/><rect x="8" y="4" width="8" height="5"/><rect x="8" y="13" width="8" height="7"/></svg>',

    samples: '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6"><rect x="3" y="3" width="8" height="8"/><rect x="13" y="3" width="8" height="8"/><rect x="3" y="13" width="8" height="8"/><rect x="13" y="13" width="8" height="8"/></svg>',
    tmpl:    '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6"><path d="M4 4h16v5H4z"/><path d="M4 11h16v9H4z"/></svg>'
  };

  // ---------- ribbon definition (mirrors Architecture grouping) ----------
  var GROUPS = [
    { label: 'FAMILY', buttons: [
      { id: 'fam-new',   name: 'New Family',  ico: I.family },
      { id: 'fam-load',  name: 'Load Family', ico: I.load   },
      { id: 'fam-edit',  name: 'Edit Family', ico: I.edit   },
      { id: 'fam-types', name: 'Types',       ico: I.types  }
    ]},
    { label: 'PARAMETERS', buttons: [
      { id: 'prm-add',   name: 'Add',        ico: I.param    },
      { id: 'prm-form',  name: 'Formula',    ico: I.formula  },
      { id: 'prm-cnst',  name: 'Constraint', ico: I.constrain},
      { id: 'prm-grp',   name: 'Group',      ico: I.group    }
    ]},
    { label: 'GEOMETRY', buttons: [
      { id: 'geo-ext',  name: 'Extrude', ico: I.extrude },
      { id: 'geo-rev',  name: 'Revolve', ico: I.revolve },
      { id: 'geo-swp',  name: 'Sweep',   ico: I.sweep   },
      { id: 'geo-bln',  name: 'Blend',   ico: I.blend   },
      { id: 'geo-boo',  name: 'Boolean', ico: I.boolean }
    ]},
    { label: 'ANALYZE', buttons: [
      { id: 'anl-regen', name: 'Regenerate', ico: I.regen   },
      { id: 'anl-diff',  name: 'Diff',       ico: I.diff    },
      { id: 'anl-save',  name: 'Persist IFC',ico: I.persist }
    ]},
    { label: 'LIBRARY', buttons: [
      { id: 'lib-samp', name: 'Samples',   ico: I.samples },
      { id: 'lib-tmpl', name: 'Templates', ico: I.tmpl    }
    ]}
  ];

  function findPanel() {
    // Strategy 1: element with data-tab="parametric"
    var el = document.querySelector('[data-tab="parametric"], [data-ribbon="parametric"]');
    if (el) return el;

    // Strategy 2: find the tab button by text, then its controlled panel
    var all = document.querySelectorAll('button, a, [role="tab"], .tab, [class*="tab"]');
    for (var i = 0; i < all.length; i++) {
      var t = (all[i].textContent || '').trim();
      if (t === 'Parametric') {
        var aria = all[i].getAttribute('aria-controls');
        if (aria) {
          var p = document.getElementById(aria);
          if (p) return p;
        }
        // Look for next sibling panel with class containing 'ribbon' or 'panel'
        var sib = all[i].nextElementSibling;
        while (sib) {
          if (sib.className && /ribbon|panel|content|tab/i.test(sib.className)) return sib;
          sib = sib.nextElementSibling;
        }
        // Fallback: nearest common ancestor's next element
        var parent = all[i].parentElement;
        if (parent && parent.nextElementSibling) return parent.nextElementSibling;
      }
    }
    return null;
  }

  function buildGroup(g) {
    var wrap = document.createElement('div');
    wrap.className = 'obs-rb-group';

    var row = document.createElement('div');
    row.className = 'obs-rb-group-row';
    g.buttons.forEach(function (b) {
      var btn = document.createElement('button');
      btn.className = 'obs-rb-btn';
      btn.type = 'button';
      btn.dataset.obsCmd = b.id;
      btn.innerHTML = '<span class="obs-rb-ico">' + b.ico + '</span>'
                    + '<span class="obs-rb-name">' + b.name + '</span>';
      row.appendChild(btn);
    });

    var lbl = document.createElement('div');
    lbl.className = 'obs-rb-label';
    lbl.textContent = g.label;

    wrap.appendChild(row);
    wrap.appendChild(lbl);
    return wrap;
  }

  function buildRibbon() {
    var root = document.createElement('div');
    root.className = 'obs-ribbon-arch';
    GROUPS.forEach(function (g) { root.appendChild(buildGroup(g)); });
    return root;
  }

  function wireEvents(root) {
    root.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
      var btn = e.target.closest('.obs-rb-btn');
      if (!btn) return;
      var cmd = btn.dataset.obsCmd;
      // Broadcast; any listener (app, bridge, extension) can react.
      window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('obs:param-ribbon-command', {
        detail: { command: cmd, source: 'parametric-ribbon' }
      }));
      console.info('[OBS-ribbon] command:', cmd);
    });
  }

  function apply() {
    var panel = findPanel();
    if (!panel) { return false; }
    // Idempotent: skip if we already replaced it
    if (panel.querySelector && panel.querySelector('.obs-ribbon-arch')) return true;

    var ribbon = buildRibbon();
    wireEvents(ribbon);

    // Preserve any state classes the original panel had
    var cls = panel.className || '';
    panel.className = cls.replace(/obs-ribbon-arch/g, '').trim() + ' obs-ribbon-panel';
    panel.innerHTML = '';
    panel.appendChild(ribbon);
    console.info('[OBS-ribbon] Parametric ribbon restyled');
    return true;
  }

  // Try a few times - app frameworks mount asynchronously
  var tries = 0;
  var t = setInterval(function () {
    tries++;
    if (apply() || tries > 100) clearInterval(t);
  }, 150);

  // Also re-apply on demand
  window.OBSRestyleParametric = function () {
    var p = findPanel();
    if (p && p.querySelector) {
      var old = p.querySelector('.obs-ribbon-arch');
      if (old) old.remove();
    }
    return apply();
  };
})();
```

```js
﻿/* public/js/openbimstudio-autodesk-bridge.js
   Consumes openbimstudio:load-properties dispatched by autodesk-import.js */
(function () {
  'use strict';
  console.info('[OpenBIMstudio] Autodesk bridge loaded.');

  window.addEventListener('openbimstudio:load-properties', function (evt) {
    var p = evt.detail.parsed;
    if (!p || !p.elements) return console.warn('[OpenBIMstudio] Empty payload.');

    console.log('[OpenBIMstudio] Received ' + p.elements.length + ' Autodesk elements');

    // Preview first 10 in a table
    console.table(p.elements.slice(0, 10).map(function (e) {
      return { dbId: e.dbId, name: e.name, externalId: e.externalId };
    }));

    // Stash globally for other modules
    window.OpenBIMStudio = window.OpenBIMStudio || {};
    window.OpenBIMStudio.autodesk = window.OpenBIMStudio.autodesk || {};
    window.OpenBIMStudio.autodesk.lastProperties = p;

    // Broadcast a secondary event so any UI panel can pick it up
    window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('openbimstudio:autodesk-ready', {
      detail: { properties: p }
    }));

    // Category histogram (quick sanity check)
    var byCategory = {};
    p.elements.forEach(function (e) {
      var c = (e.properties || []).find(function (x) {
        return x.displayName === 'Category' || x.attributeName === 'Category';
      });
      var key = c ? c.displayValue : '(unknown)';
      byCategory[key] = (byCategory[key] || 0) + 1;
    });
    console.log('[OpenBIMstudio] Categories:', byCategory);
  });
})();
```

```js
      '#'+PANEL_ID+' .obim-tnode .label{flex:1;color:#e6edf3;',
      'overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;}',
      '#'+PANEL_ID+' .obim-tnode .count{color:#7d8590;font-size:11.5px;}',
      '#'+PANEL_ID+' .obim-tsub{padding-left:22px;}',
      '#'+PANEL_ID+' .obim-foot{padding:8px 12px;border-top:1px solid #1f2630;',
      'color:#7d8590;font-size:11.5px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;}',
      '#'+PANEL_ID+' .obim-cat{color:#0a84ff;font-size:11.5px;}',
      '#'+HANDLE_ID+'{position:fixed;top:50%;right:0;transform:translateY(-50%);',
      'z-index:2147482999;background:#0a84ff;color:#fff;border:none;',
      'padding:14px 8px;border-radius:8px 0 0 8px;cursor:pointer;',
      'writing-mode:vertical-lr;font:600 12px/1 system-ui,sans-serif;',
      'letter-spacing:1px;box-shadow:-3px 0 12px rgba(0,102,204,.35);}',
      '#'+HANDLE_ID+':hover{background:#0066cc;}'
    ].join('');
    document.head.appendChild(s);
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- helpers
  function esc(s) {
    return String(s == null ? '' : s)
      .replace(/&/g,'&amp;').replace(/</g,'&lt;').replace(/>/g,'&gt;')
      .replace(/"/g,'&quot;').replace(/'/g,'&#39;');
  }
  function getProp(el, name) {
    if (!el || !el.properties) return null;
    for (var i = 0; i < el.properties.length; i++) {
      var p = el.properties[i];
      if (p.displayName === name || p.attributeName === name) return p.displayValue;
    }
    return null;
  }
  function matches(el, q) {
    if (!q) return true;
    if ((el.name || '').toLowerCase().indexOf(q) !== -1) return true;
    if ((el.externalId || '').toLowerCase().indexOf(q) !== -1) return true;
    var c = getProp(el, 'Category');
    if (c && String(c).toLowerCase().indexOf(q) !== -1) return true;
    var t = getProp(el, 'Type Name');
    if (t && String(t).toLowerCase().indexOf(q) !== -1) return true;
    return false;
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- build
  function buildHandle() {
    if (document.getElementById(HANDLE_ID)) return;
    var h = document.createElement('button');
    h.id = HANDLE_ID;
    h.type = 'button';
    h.textContent = 'AUTODESK';
    h.title = 'Open Autodesk imported data';
    h.addEventListener('click', function () { state.open ? close() : open(); });
    document.body.appendChild(h);
    h.style.display = 'none';
  }

  function buildPanel() {
    if (document.getElementById(PANEL_ID)) return;
    var p = document.createElement('aside');
    p.id = PANEL_ID;
    p.innerHTML =
      '<div class="obim-head">' +
      '  <div class="obim-tabs">' +
      '    <button class="obim-tab active" data-tab="props">Properties</button>' +
      '    <button class="obim-tab" data-tab="tree">Tree</button>' +
      '  </div>' +
      '  <button class="obim-close" title="Close">&#x2715;</button>' +
      '</div>' +
      '<div class="obim-search"><input type="text" id="obim-q" placeholder="Search name, type, category, externalId…"/></div>' +
      '<div class="obim-body" id="obim-body"></div>' +
      '<div class="obim-foot"><span id="obim-count">0 elements</span><span class="obim-cat">Autodesk</span></div>';
    document.body.appendChild(p);

    p.querySelector('.obim-close').addEventListener('click', close);
    p.querySelectorAll('.obim-tab').forEach(function (t) {
      t.addEventListener('click', function () {
        state.tab = t.getAttribute('data-tab');
        p.querySelectorAll('.obim-tab').forEach(function (x) { x.classList.remove('active'); });
        t.classList.add('active');
        render();
      });
    });
    p.querySelector('#obim-q').addEventListener('input', function (e) {
      state.query = e.target.value.trim().toLowerCase();
      state.page = 0;
      render();
    });
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- render
  function render() {
    var body = document.getElementById('obim-body');
    if (!body) return;
    body.innerHTML = '';
    if (state.tab === 'tree') renderTree(body);
    else renderList(body);
    document.getElementById('obim-count').textContent = state.elements.length + ' elements';
  }

  function filtered() {
    if (!state.query) return state.elements;
    var q = state.query;
    var out = [];
    for (var i = 0; i < state.elements.length; i++) {
      if (matches(state.elements[i], q)) out.push(state.elements[i]);
    }
    return out;
  }

  function renderList(body) {
    var list = filtered();
    if (!list.length) {
      body.innerHTML = '<div class="obim-empty">No elements match.</div>';
      if (state.selected) renderDetail(body, state.selected);
      return;
    }
    var wrap = document.createElement('div');
    wrap.className = 'obim-list';
    body.appendChild(wrap);

    var shown = 0;
    function chunk() {
      var end = Math.min(shown + state.PAGE, list.length);
      var html = '';
      for (var i = shown; i < end; i++) {
        var el = list[i];
        var cat = getProp(el, 'Category') || '';
        var tn  = getProp(el, 'Type Name') || '';
        html += '<div class="obim-row" data-idx="' + i + '">' +
                  '<div class="obim-name">' + esc(el.name || '(unnamed)') + '</div>' +
                  '<div class="obim-sub">' + esc(cat) + (tn ? ' · ' + esc(tn) : '') + ' · dbId ' + esc(el.dbId) + '</div>' +
                '</div>';
      }
      wrap.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend', html);
      shown = end;
      if (shown < list.length) requestAnimationFrame(chunk);
    }
    chunk();

    wrap.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
      var row = e.target.closest('.obim-row');
      if (!row) return;
      var idx = +row.getAttribute('data-idx');
      state.selected = list[idx];
      wrap.querySelectorAll('.obim-row.sel').forEach(function (x) { x.classList.remove('sel'); });
      row.classList.add('sel');
      var existing = body.querySelector('.obim-detail');
      if (existing) existing.remove();
      renderDetail(body, state.selected);
    });

    if (state.selected) renderDetail(body, state.selected);
  }

  function renderDetail(body, el) {
    var rows = (el.properties || []).map(function (p) {
      return '<tr><td>' + esc(p.displayName) + '</td><td>' + esc(p.displayValue) + '</td></tr>';
    }).join('');
    var det = document.createElement('div');
    det.className = 'obim-detail';
    det.innerHTML =
      '<h4>' + esc(el.name || '(unnamed)') + '</h4>' +
      '<div class="obim-id">dbId ' + esc(el.dbId) +
      (el.externalId ? ' · externalId ' + esc(el.externalId) : '') + '</div>' +
      '<table>' + rows + '</table>';
    body.appendChild(det);
    det.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'nearest' });
  }

  function renderTree(body) {
    var tree = {};
    for (var i = 0; i < state.elements.length; i++) {
      var el  = state.elements[i];
      if (state.query && !matches(el, state.query)) continue;
      var cat = getProp(el, 'Category') || '(unknown)';
      var tn  = getProp(el, 'Type Name') || '(no type)';
      if (!tree[cat]) tree[cat] = {};
      if (!tree[cat][tn]) tree[cat][tn] = [];
      tree[cat][tn].push(el);
    }
    var cats = Object.keys(tree).sort();
    if (!cats.length) {
      body.innerHTML = '<div class="obim-empty">Nothing to show.</div>';
      return;
    }
    var wrap = document.createElement('div');
    wrap.className = 'obim-tree';

    cats.forEach(function (cat) {
      var types = Object.keys(tree[cat]).sort();
      var total = types.reduce(function (a, t) { return a + tree[cat][t].length; }, 0);
      var node = document.createElement('div');
      node.innerHTML =
        '<div class="obim-tnode obim-cat-node">' +
          '<span class="caret">&#x25B6;</span>' +
          '<span class="label">' + esc(cat) + '</span>' +
          '<span class="count">' + total + '</span>' +
        '</div>' +
        '<div class="obim-tsub" style="display:none"></div>';
      var catNode = node.firstChild;
      var sub     = node.lastChild;
      catNode.addEventListener('click', function () {
        var open = sub.style.display !== 'none';
        sub.style.display = open ? 'none' : 'block';
        catNode.querySelector('.caret').textContent = open ? '\u25B6' : '\u25BC';
        if (!open && !sub.dataset.built) {
          sub.dataset.built = '1';
          var html = '';
          types.forEach(function (tn) {
            html += '<div class="obim-tnode obim-type-node">' +
                      '<span class="caret">&#x25B6;</span>' +
                      '<span class="label">' + esc(tn) + '</span>' +
                      '<span class="count">' + tree[cat][tn].length + '</span>' +
                    '</div>' +
                    '<div class="obim-tsub" style="display:none"></div>';
          });
          sub.innerHTML = html;
          sub.querySelectorAll('.obim-type-node').forEach(function (typeNode, ti) {
            var typeSub = typeNode.nextElementSibling;
            var tn = types[ti];
            typeNode.addEventListener('click', function () {
              var to = typeSub.style.display !== 'none';
              typeSub.style.display = to ? 'none' : 'block';
              typeNode.querySelector('.caret').textContent = to ? '\u25B6' : '\u25BC';
              if (!to && !typeSub.dataset.built) {
                typeSub.dataset.built = '1';
                var h = '';
                tree[cat][tn].slice(0, 2000).forEach(function (el) {
                  h += '<div class="obim-row" data-dbid="' + esc(el.dbId) + '">' +
                         '<div class="obim-name">' + esc(el.name || '(unnamed)') + '</div>' +
                         '<div class="obim-sub">dbId ' + esc(el.dbId) + '</div>' +
                       '</div>';
                });
                typeSub.innerHTML = h;
              }
            });
          });
        }
      });
      wrap.appendChild(node);
    });

    wrap.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
      var row = e.target.closest('.obim-row');
      if (!row) return;
      var dbid = row.getAttribute('data-dbid');
      var el = state.elements.find(function (x) { return String(x.dbId) === dbid; });
      if (el) {
        state.selected = el;
        var body = document.getElementById('obim-body');
        var existing = body.querySelector('.obim-detail');
        if (existing) existing.remove();
        renderDetail(body, el);
      }
    });

    body.appendChild(wrap);
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- control
  function open() {
    var p = document.getElementById(PANEL_ID);
    if (!p) return;
    p.classList.add('open');
    state.open = true;
    var h = document.getElementById(HANDLE_ID);
    if (h) h.style.display = 'none';
  }
  function close() {
    var p = document.getElementById(PANEL_ID);
    if (!p) return;
    p.classList.remove('open');
    state.open = false;
    var h = document.getElementById(HANDLE_ID);
    if (h) h.style.display = '';
  }

  function setElements(list) {
    state.elements = list || [];
    state.page = 0;
    state.selected = null;
    render();
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- wire
  window.addEventListener('openbimstudio:autodesk-ready', function (e) {
    if (!e.detail || !e.detail.properties) return;
    var p = e.detail.properties;
    setElements(p.elements || []);
    open();
    console.info('[OpenBIMstudio] Autodesk panel populated with', state.elements.length, 'elements.');
  });

  function boot() {
    injectStyles();
    buildHandle();
    buildPanel();
  }
  if (document.readyState === 'loading') document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', boot);
  else boot();
})();
```

```html
﻿<!doctype html>
<html>
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8" />
  <title>Revit Parametric Engine - Demo</title>
  <style>
    body { font: 13px/1.5 -apple-system, Segoe UI, sans-serif; margin: 0; }
    #app { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 320px 1fr; height: 100vh; }
    aside { background: #111; color: #eee; padding: 16px; overflow: auto; }
    aside h2 { margin: 0 0 8px; font-size: 14px; color: #9cf; }
    aside label { display: block; margin: 8px 0 2px; font-size: 11px; color: #aaa; }
    aside input[type=range] { width: 100%; }
    aside button { background: #2563eb; color: #fff; border: 0; padding: 6px 10px; border-radius: 4px; cursor: pointer; }
    main { padding: 16px; overflow: auto; font-family: ui-monospace, Consolas, monospace; font-size: 12px; }
    pre { background: #f5f5f5; padding: 10px; border-radius: 6px; overflow: auto; }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
<div id="app">
  <aside>
    <h2>Parametric Door Family</h2>
    <label>Width (m) <span id="wv">0.90</span></label>
    <input id="w" type="range" min="0.6" max="1.6" step="0.05" value="0.9" />
    <label>Height (m) <span id="hv">2.10</span></label>
    <input id="h" type="range" min="1.8" max="2.6" step="0.05" value="2.1" />
    <label>Thickness (m) <span id="tv">0.05</span></label>
    <input id="t" type="range" min="0.03" max="0.12" step="0.005" value="0.05" />
    <p style="color:#888">Move any slider to regenerate.</p>
    <button id="undo">Undo last change</button>
  </aside>
  <main>
    <div id="status">Loading...</div>
    <pre id="out"></pre>
  </main>
</div>

<script src="./web-ifc/revit-parametric-engine.js"></script>
<script>
  var out = document.getElementById('out');
  var statusEl = document.getElementById('status');
  var undoBtn = document.getElementById('undo');
  var RE = window.RevitParametricEngine;
  var engine = new RE.RevitParametricEngine(null, 0, { autoRegen: false });

  engine.defineFamily('Door', {
    category: 'Doors',
    parameters: [
      { name: 'Width',     kind: 'Length', isType: true, default: 0.9 },
      { name: 'Height',    kind: 'Length', isType: true, default: 2.1 },
      { name: 'Thickness', kind: 'Length', isType: true, default: 0.05 }
    ],
    formulas: [
      'Area  = Width * Height',
      'Frame = Width + 0.1'
    ],
    constraints: [ new RE.Constraint('range', ['Width'], { min: 0.5, max: 2.0 }) ],
    geometry: function(p) {
      return {
        kind: 'Extrusion',
        profile: { kind: 'Rectangle', width: 'Width', height: 'Height' },
        depth: 'Thickness',
        origin: { x: 0, y: 0, z: 0 }
      };
    }
  });

  engine.defineType('Door', 'Type-A');
  engine.bindInstance(1001, 'Door', 'Type-A');

  var history = [];

  function render() {
    var ctx = engine.effectiveParameters(1001);
    var records = engine.regenerate({ dryRun: true });
    out.textContent = JSON.stringify({
      parameters: ctx,
      geometry: records[0] ? records[0].geometry : null
    }, null, 2);
    statusEl.textContent = 'Regenerated ' + records.length + ' instance(s).';
  }

  function push() {
    var t = engine.families.get('Door').types.get('Type-A');
    history.push(new Map(t.params));
    if (history.length > 50) history.shift();
  }

  function bind(id, name, viewId) {
    var el = document.getElementById(id);
    var vw = document.getElementById(viewId);
    el.addEventListener('input', function() {
      push();
      var v = parseFloat(el.value);
      vw.textContent = v.toFixed(2);
      engine.setTypeParameter('Door', 'Type-A', name, v);
      render();
    });
  }
  bind('w', 'Width', 'wv');
  bind('h', 'Height', 'hv');
  bind('t', 'Thickness', 'tv');

  undoBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
    var prev = history.pop();
    if (!prev) return;
    var t = engine.families.get('Door').types.get('Type-A');
    prev.forEach(function(v, k) { t.set(k, v); });
    engine._dirty.add(1001);
    render();
  });

  render();
</script>
<!-- OPENBIMSTUDIO-PARAMETRIC-BRIDGE -->

<script src="/web-ifc/openbimstudio-parametric-persist.js"></script>
</body>
</html>
```

```ts
     * @param inverse default false, if true get all inverse properties recursively
     * @returns IfcElement
     */
    getItemProperties(modelID: number, id: number, recursive?: boolean, inverse?: boolean): Promise<any>;

    getPropertySets(modelID: number, elementID?: number, recursive?: boolean, includeTypeProperties?: boolean): Promise<any[]>;

     * @param modelID model handle

     * @param psetID expressID or array of expressIDs of IfcPropertySets
     * @returns true if success or false if error

    setPropertySets(modelID: number, elementID: number | number[], psetID: number | number[]): Promise<boolean>;
    /**
     * Get TypeObject of IfcElements
     * @param modelID model handle
     * @param elementID expressID of IfcElement, default 0 (all type objects in model)
     * @param recursive default false, if true get all nested properties of the type object recursively
     * @returns array of objects inheriting from IfcTypeObject
     */
    getTypeProperties(modelID: number, elementID?: number, recursive?: boolean): Promise<any[]>;
    /**
     * Get materials of IfcElement
     * @param modelID model handle
     * @param elementID expressID of IfcElement, default 0 (all materials in model)
     * @param recursive default false, if true get all nested properties recursively
     * @returns array of IfcElements inheriting from IfcMaterialDefinition
     */
    getMaterialsProperties(modelID: number, elementID?: number, recursive?: boolean, includeTypeMaterials?: boolean): Promise<any[]>;
    /**
     * Set IfcRelAssociatesMaterial relations of IfcElements and IfcMaterialDefinitions
     * @param modelID model handle
     * @param elementID expressID or array of expressIDs of IfcElements
     * @param materialID expressID or array of expressIDs of IfcMaterialDefinitions
     * @returns true if success or false if error
     */
    setMaterialsProperties(modelID: number, elementID: number | number[], materialID: number | number[]): Promise<boolean>;
    /**
     * Get Spatial Structure of IfcProject
     * @param modelID model handle
     * @param includeProperties default false
     * @returns IfcProject as Node
     */
    getSpatialStructure(modelID: number, includeProperties?: boolean): Promise<Node>;
```

--- FILE: public/web-ifc/openbimstudio-parametric-bridge.js ---
```js
/* ============================================================================
 * openbimstudio-parametric-bridge.js
 * Runtime bridge: hooks WebIFCWasm so every OpenModel() automatically
 * receives a parametric engine (api.parametric).
 *
 * Emits:
 *   window event 'obs:parametric-ready'      -> { api, modelID, engine }
 *   window event 'obs:parametric-regenerate' -> { modelID, diff }
 *
 * Access anywhere:
 *   window.OpenBIMStudio.parametric.getEngine()
 *   window.OpenBIMStudio.parametric.getModelID()
 * ========================================================================== */
(function () {
  'use strict';
  if (window.__OBS_PARAMETRIC_BRIDGE__) return;
  window.__OBS_PARAMETRIC_BRIDGE__ = true;

  var engine = null;
  var currentModelID = null;
  var currentApi = null;

  function patchWasm() {
    if (!window.WebIFCWasm) return false;
    if (window.WebIFCWasm.__obsWrapped) return true;
    if (!window.RevitParametricEngine) {
      console.warn('[OBS-parametric] RevitParametricEngine not loaded yet - retrying');
      return false;
    }

    var orig = window.WebIFCWasm;
    var wrapped = async function () {
      var api = await orig.apply(null, arguments);

      if (api && typeof api.OpenModel === 'function' && !api.__obsOpenPatched) {
        var origOpen = api.OpenModel.bind(api);

        api.OpenModel = function () {
          var modelID = origOpen.apply(null, arguments);
          try {
            var eng = api.createParametricEngine(modelID, {
              autoRegen: false,
              onRegenerate: function (diff) {
                try {
                  window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('obs:parametric-regenerate', {
                    detail: { modelID: modelID, diff: diff }
                  }));
                } catch (e) {}
              },
              onError: function (e) { console.warn('[OBS-parametric]', e); }
            });

            engine = eng;
            currentModelID = modelID;
            currentApi = api;
            api.parametric = eng;

            window.OpenBIMStudio = window.OpenBIMStudio || {};
            window.OpenBIMStudio.parametric = window.OpenBIMStudio.parametric || {};
            window.OpenBIMStudio.parametric.engine    = eng;
            window.OpenBIMStudio.parametric.modelID   = modelID;
            window.OpenBIMStudio.parametric.api       = api;
            window.OpenBIMStudio.parametric.getEngine = function () { return engine; };
            window.OpenBIMStudio.parametric.getModelID= function () { return currentModelID; };

            try {
              window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('obs:parametric-ready', {
                detail: { api: api, modelID: modelID, engine: eng }
              }));
            } catch (e) {}

            try { eng.loadFamilies(); } catch (e) {}
          } catch (e) {
            console.warn('[OBS-parametric] failed to attach engine:', e);
          }
          return modelID;
        };

        try { Object.defineProperty(api, '__obsOpenPatched', { value: true }); } catch (e) {}
      }
      return api;
    };

    Object.keys(orig).forEach(function (k) {
      try { wrapped[k] = orig[k]; } catch (e) {}
    });
    wrapped.default = wrapped;
    try { Object.defineProperty(wrapped, '__obsWrapped', { value: true }); } catch (e) {}

    window.WebIFCWasm = wrapped;
    console.info('[OBS-parametric] WebIFCWasm hooked');
    return true;
  }

  var tries = 0;
  var poll = setInterval(function () {
    tries++;
    if (patchWasm() || tries > 400) { clearInterval(poll); }
  }, 50);

  window.OpenBIMStudio = window.OpenBIMStudio || {};
  window.OpenBIMStudio.parametric = window.OpenBIMStudio.parametric || {};
  window.OpenBIMStudio.parametric.getEngine  = function () { return engine; };
  window.OpenBIMStudio.parametric.getModelID = function () { return currentModelID; };
  window.OpenBIMStudio.parametric.ready = function (cb) {
    if (engine) return cb(engine, currentModelID);
    window.addEventListener('obs:parametric-ready', function (e) {
      cb(e.detail.engine, e.detail.modelID);
    }, { once: true });
  };
})();

```
