--- FILE: public/web-ifc/openbimstudio-parametric-persist.js ---
```js
/* ============================================================================
 * openbimstudio-parametric-persist.js
 * Write-back support:
 *   engine.toIFC()                -> Uint8Array of the current model
 *   engine.downloadIFC(filename)  -> triggers browser download
 *   engine.persist(diff)          -> writes ifcLines into the model (best-effort)
 * Auto-persists after every regenerate when window.__obsAutoPersist === true.
 * ========================================================================== */
(function () {
  'use strict';
  if (window.__OBS_PARAM_PERSIST__) return;
  window.__OBS_PARAM_PERSIST__ = true;

  function findModelApi(engine) {
    if (engine.api) return engine.api;
    if (window.OpenBIMStudio && window.OpenBIMStudio.parametric) {
      return window.OpenBIMStudio.parametric.api;
    }
    return null;
  }

  function nextExpressID(api, modelID) {
    try {
      if (typeof api.GetMaxExpressID === 'function') {
        return api.GetMaxExpressID(modelID) + 1;
      }
    } catch (e) {}
    // Fallback: scan all lines
    var max = 0;
    var ids = api.GetAllLines(modelID);
    for (var i = 0; i < ids.size(); i++) { var v = ids.get(i); if (v > max) max = v; }
    return max + 1;
  }

  function writeLine(api, modelID, line) {
    if (typeof api.CreateIfcEntity === 'function') {
      var id = api.CreateIfcEntity(modelID, line.type);
      api.WriteLine(modelID, id, line);
      return id;
    }
    if (typeof api.WriteLine === 'function') {
      var nid = nextExpressID(api, modelID);
      api.WriteLine(modelID, nid, line);
      return nid;
    }
    throw new Error('web-ifc API has no WriteLine/CreateIfcEntity');
  }

  function attachPersistence(engine, modelID) {
    if (!engine || engine.__persistAttached) return engine;
    var api = findModelApi(engine);
    if (!api) { console.warn('[OBS-persist] no api reference on engine'); return engine; }

    engine.__persistAttached = true;

    engine.toIFC = function () {
      if (typeof api.SaveModel !== 'function') {
        throw new Error('SaveModel not available on this web-ifc build');
      }
      var bytes = api.SaveModel(modelID);
      return bytes instanceof Uint8Array ? bytes : new Uint8Array(bytes);
    };

    engine.downloadIFC = function (filename) {
      var bytes = engine.toIFC();
      var blob  = new Blob([bytes], { type: 'application/x-step' });
      var url   = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      var a = document.createElement('a');
      a.href = url;
      a.download = filename || 'model.ifc';
      document.body.appendChild(a);
      a.click();
      document.body.removeChild(a);
      setTimeout(function () { URL.revokeObjectURL(url); }, 500);
      return bytes;
    };

    engine.persist = function (diff) {
      if (!Array.isArray(diff)) throw new Error('persist(diff) requires the diff array from regenerate()');
      var written = 0;
      for (var i = 0; i < diff.length; i++) {
        var rec = diff[i];
        if (!rec.ifcLines || !rec.ifcLines.length) continue;
        for (var j = 0; j < rec.ifcLines.length; j++) {
          try { writeLine(api, modelID, rec.ifcLines[j]); written++; }
          catch (e) { console.warn('[OBS-persist] writeLine failed:', e); }
        }
      }
      console.info('[OBS-persist] wrote', written, 'entity line(s)');
      return written;
    };

    // Optional auto-persist on regen
    var origRegen = engine.regenerate.bind(engine);
    engine.regenerate = function () {
      var diff = origRegen.apply(null, arguments);
      if (window.__obsAutoPersist) {
        try { engine.persist(diff); } catch (e) { console.warn('[OBS-persist]', e); }
      }
      return diff;
    };

    return engine;
  }

  window.addEventListener('obs:parametric-ready', function (e) {
    var engine = e.detail.engine;
    var modelID = e.detail.modelID;
    try { attachPersistence(engine, modelID); console.info('[OBS-persist] attached'); }
    catch (err) { console.warn('[OBS-persist] attach failed:', err); }
  });

  window.OpenBIMStudio = window.OpenBIMStudio || {};
  window.OpenBIMStudio.parametric = window.OpenBIMStudio.parametric || {};
  window.OpenBIMStudio.parametric.enableAutoPersist = function (on) {
    window.__obsAutoPersist = on !== false;
    console.info('[OBS-persist] autoPersist =', window.__obsAutoPersist);
  };
})();

```
--- END FILE ---

--- FILE: public/web-ifc/openbimstudio-parametric-renderer.js ---
```js
/* ============================================================================
 * openbimstudio-parametric-renderer.js
 * Registry so your app can plug its own renderer into the parametric engine.
 *
 * Public API:
 *   window.OpenBIMStudio.parametric.registerRenderer({
 *     name: 'three' | 'babylon' | 'custom',
 *     updateElement: function (expressID, geometry, record) {},
 *     removeElement: function (expressID) {},
 *     clear: function () {}
 *   });
 *
 * Auto fallback: if window.THREE exists and no renderer is registered,
 * a naive BoxGeometry adapter attaches itself to window.__obsScene.
 * ========================================================================== */
(function () {
  'use strict';
  var bus = window.OpenBIMStudio = window.OpenBIMStudio || {};
  bus.parametric = bus.parametric || {};

  var active = null;
  var queue = [];

  function dispatch(record) {
    if (!active) { queue.push(record); return; }
    try { active.updateElement(record.expressID, record.geometry, record); }
    catch (e) { console.warn('[OBS-renderer] updateElement failed:', e); }
  }

  function flushQueue() {
    while (queue.length && active) dispatch(queue.shift());
  }

  bus.parametric.registerRenderer = function (impl) {
    if (!impl || typeof impl.updateElement !== 'function') {
      throw new Error('registerRenderer requires { updateElement }');
    }
    active = {
      name: impl.name || 'custom',
      updateElement: impl.updateElement,
      removeElement: impl.removeElement || function () {},
      clear: impl.clear || function () {}
    };
    console.info('[OBS-renderer] registered:', active.name);
    flushQueue();
    return active;
  };

  bus.parametric.getRenderer = function () { return active; };

  window.addEventListener('obs:parametric-regenerate', function (e) {
    var diff = (e.detail && e.detail.diff) || [];
    for (var i = 0; i < diff.length; i++) dispatch(diff[i]);
  });

  // ---- naive Three.js fallback (only if no explicit renderer registered) ----
  function tryAutoThree() {
    if (active) return;
    if (!window.THREE) return;
    if (window.__obsRendererAttached) return;
    window.__obsRendererAttached = true;

    var scene = window.__obsScene;
    if (!scene) {
      console.info('[OBS-renderer] THREE detected but window.__obsScene is missing. '
                 + 'Assign your scene to window.__obsScene or call registerRenderer().');
      return;
    }
    var meshes = new Map();
    var mat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x66aaff, side: THREE.DoubleSide });

    function dispose(mesh) {
      if (mesh.geometry) mesh.geometry.dispose();
      scene.remove(mesh);
    }

    bus.parametric.registerRenderer({
      name: 'three-fallback',
      updateElement: function (expressID, geom) {
        if (!geom || geom.kind !== 'Extrusion') return;
        var w = geom.profile.width  || 0.5;
        var d = geom.profile.height || 0.5;
        var h = geom.depth || 1;

        var mesh = meshes.get(expressID);
        if (mesh) dispose(mesh);
        mesh = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(w, h, d), mat);
        if (geom.origin) mesh.position.set(geom.origin.x || 0, geom.origin.z || 0, geom.origin.y || 0);
        scene.add(mesh);
        meshes.set(expressID, mesh);
      },
      removeElement: function (expressID) {
        var m = meshes.get(expressID); if (m) { dispose(m); meshes.delete(expressID); }
      },
      clear: function () {
        meshes.forEach(dispose); meshes.clear();
      }
    });
    console.info('[OBS-renderer] Three.js fallback attached to window.__obsScene');
  }

  // Poll for THREE (bundle may load after this script)
  var tries = 0;
  var t = setInterval(function () {
    tries++;
    tryAutoThree();
    if (active || tries > 200) clearInterval(t);
  }, 100);
})();

```

/* ============================================================================
 * openbimstudio-parametric-ui.js
 * Floating panel that auto-discovers families and shows parameter sliders.
 * Zero app code needed. Toggle with Ctrl+Shift+P or click the header.
 * ========================================================================== */
(function () {
  'use strict';
  if (window.__OBS_PARAM_UI__) return;
  window.__OBS_PARAM_UI__ = true;

  var style = document.createElement('style');
  style.textContent = [
    '#obs-param-panel{position:fixed;right:16px;bottom:16px;width:320px;max-height:70vh;overflow:auto;',
    'background:#0f1116;color:#e6e8ee;font:12px/1.4 -apple-system,Segoe UI,sans-serif;',
    'border:1px solid #2a2f3a;border-radius:8px;box-shadow:0 12px 32px rgba(0,0,0,.35);z-index:2147483647;}',
    '#obs-param-panel header{padding:8px 10px;background:#161a22;border-bottom:1px solid #2a2f3a;',
    'cursor:pointer;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;font-weight:600;color:#9cf;}',
    '#obs-param-panel .body{padding:10px;}',
    '#obs-param-panel.collapsed .body{display:none;}',
    '#obs-param-panel select,#obs-param-panel input[type=text],#obs-param-panel input[type=number]',
    '{width:100%;background:#0b0d12;color:#e6e8ee;border:1px solid #2a2f3a;border-radius:4px;padding:4px 6px;}',
    '#obs-param-panel .row{margin:6px 0;}',
    '#obs-param-panel .row label{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;color:#9aa4b2;font-size:11px;}',
    '#obs-param-panel input[type=range]{width:100%;}',
    '#obs-param-panel .btns{display:flex;gap:6px;margin-top:8px;}',
    '#obs-param-panel button{flex:1;background:#2563eb;color:#fff;border:0;border-radius:4px;padding:6px;cursor:pointer;}',
    '#obs-param-panel button.sec{background:#2a2f3a;}',
    '#obs-param-panel .empty{color:#6b7280;font-style:italic;padding:6px 0;}'
  ].join('');
  document.head.appendChild(style);

  var panel = document.createElement('div');
  panel.id = 'obs-param-panel';
  panel.innerHTML = ''
    + '<header><span>Parametric</span><span id="obs-param-toggle">[ - ]</span></header>'
    + '<div class="body">'
    +   '<div id="obs-param-content"><div class="empty">Waiting for a model...</div></div>'
    + '</div>';
  document.body.appendChild(panel);

  document.querySelector('#obs-param-panel header').addEventListener('click', function () {
    panel.classList.toggle('collapsed');
    document.getElementById('obs-param-toggle').textContent =
      panel.classList.contains('collapsed') ? '[ + ]' : '[ - ]';
  });

  document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
    if (e.ctrlKey && e.shiftKey && (e.key === 'P' || e.key === 'p')) {
      e.preventDefault();
      panel.classList.toggle('collapsed');
    }
  });

  var currentEngine = null;
  var currentFamily = null;
  var currentType   = null;
  var typeSnapshot  = null;

  function getParamKind(engine, familyName, pname) {
    var fam = engine.families.get(familyName);
    if (!fam) return 'Number';
    var p = fam.parameters.get(pname) || fam.instanceParameters.get(pname);
    return (p && p.kind) || 'Number';
  }

  function render() {
    var content = document.getElementById('obs-param-content');
    content.innerHTML = '';

    if (!currentEngine) {
      content.innerHTML = '<div class="empty">Waiting for a model...</div>';
      return;
    }

    var families = currentEngine.listFamilies();
    if (!families.length) {
      content.innerHTML = '<div class="empty">No families in this IFC. Use engine.defineFamily() to add one.</div>';
      return;
    }

    var famSel = document.createElement('select');
    families.forEach(function (f) {
      var o = document.createElement('option');
      o.value = f.name; o.textContent = f.name + ' (' + f.typeCount + ')';
      famSel.appendChild(o);
    });
    if (currentFamily && families.some(function (f) { return f.name === currentFamily; })) {
      famSel.value = currentFamily;
    } else {
      currentFamily = families[0].name;
    }
    content.appendChild(row('Family', famSel));

    var types = currentEngine.listTypes(currentFamily);
    if (!types.length) {
      content.innerHTML += '<div class="empty">This family has no types yet.</div>';
      return;
    }
    var typeSel = document.createElement('select');
    types.forEach(function (t) {
      var o = document.createElement('option'); o.value = t; o.textContent = t;
      typeSel.appendChild(o);
    });
    if (currentType && types.indexOf(currentType) >= 0) typeSel.value = currentType;
    else currentType = types[0];
    content.appendChild(row('Type', typeSel));

    var fam = currentEngine.families.get(currentFamily);
    var typeObj = fam.types.get(currentType);
    var params = [];
    fam.parameters.forEach(function (p, k) { params.push([k, p]); });
    fam.instanceParameters.forEach(function (p, k) { params.push([k, p]); });

    params.forEach(function (pair) {
      var pname = pair[0], pdef = pair[1];
      var kind  = pdef.kind;
      var val   = typeObj.get(pname);
      content.appendChild(paramRow(pname, kind, val, pdef.isReadOnly));
    });

    var btns = document.createElement('div');
    btns.className = 'btns';
    var bUndo = document.createElement('button');
    bUndo.className = 'sec'; bUndo.textContent = 'Revert';
    bUndo.onclick = function () {
      if (!typeSnapshot) return;
      typeSnapshot.forEach(function (v, k) { typeObj.set(k, v); });
      currentEngine._dirty.clear();
      currentEngine.regenerate();
      render();
    };
    var bSave = document.createElement('button');
    bSave.textContent = 'Download IFC';
    bSave.onclick = function () {
      if (currentEngine.downloadIFC) {
        currentEngine.downloadIFC('openbimstudio-parametric.ifc');
      } else {
        alert('Persistence module not loaded. Add openbimstudio-parametric-persist.js');
      }
    };
    btns.appendChild(bUndo); btns.appendChild(bSave);
    content.appendChild(btns);

    function onFamilyChange() {
      currentFamily = famSel.value;
      currentType   = null;
      render();
    }
    famSel.onchange = onFamilyChange;
    typeSel.onchange = function () { currentType = typeSel.value; render(); };
  }

  function row(label, inputEl) {
    var d = document.createElement('div'); d.className = 'row';
    var l = document.createElement('label'); l.textContent = label;
    d.appendChild(l); d.appendChild(inputEl);
    return d;
  }

  function paramRow(name, kind, value, readOnly) {
    var d = document.createElement('div'); d.className = 'row';
    var l = document.createElement('label');
    var spanVal = document.createElement('span'); spanVal.textContent = (value == null ? '' : value);
    l.textContent = name; l.appendChild(spanVal);
    d.appendChild(l);

    if (kind === 'YesNo') {
      var cb = document.createElement('input');
      cb.type = 'checkbox';
      cb.checked = !!value;
      cb.disabled = !!readOnly;
      cb.onchange = function () { apply(name, cb.checked ? 1 : 0, spanVal, cb.checked ? 1 : 0); };
      d.appendChild(cb);
    } else if (kind === 'Text' || kind === 'Material' || kind === 'URL' || kind === 'FamilyType') {
      var ti = document.createElement('input');
      ti.type = 'text'; ti.value = value == null ? '' : value;
      ti.disabled = !!readOnly;
      ti.onchange = function () { apply(name, ti.value, spanVal, ti.value); };
      d.appendChild(ti);
    } else {
      var isInt = (kind === 'Integer');
      var step = isInt ? 1 : (kind === 'Length' ? 0.01 : 0.1);
      var num = Number(value) || 0;
      var rng = document.createElement('input');
      rng.type = 'range';
      var min = Math.min(0, num * 0.1);
      var max = Math.max(1, num * 3);
      if (kind === 'Length') { min = 0; max = Math.max(1, num * 3); }
      rng.min = min; rng.max = max; rng.step = step; rng.value = num;
      rng.disabled = !!readOnly;
      rng.oninput = function () { apply(name, parseFloat(rng.value), spanVal, parseFloat(rng.value).toFixed(2)); };
      d.appendChild(rng);
    }
    return d;
  }

  function apply(name, value, spanVal, displayVal) {
    if (!currentEngine) return;
    if (!typeSnapshot) {
      typeSnapshot = new Map(currentEngine.families.get(currentFamily).types.get(currentType).params);
    }
    try {
      currentEngine.setTypeParameter(currentFamily, currentType, name, value);
      spanVal.textContent = displayVal;
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('[OBS-ui]', e);
    }
  }

  window.addEventListener('obs:parametric-ready', function (e) {
    currentEngine = e.detail.engine;
    currentFamily = null;
    currentType   = null;
    typeSnapshot  = null;
    render();
  });

  // Also expose a manual refresh
  window.OpenBIMStudio = window.OpenBIMStudio || {};
  window.OpenBIMStudio.parametric = window.OpenBIMStudio.parametric || {};
  window.OpenBIMStudio.parametric.refreshUI = render;
})();

```md
<p align="center">

![cover](banner.png)

<h1>Web IFC <img src="https://thatopen.github.io/engine_components/resources/favicon.ico" width="32"/></h1>

[![NPM Package][npm]][npm-url]
[![NPM Package][npm-downloads]][npm-url]

**web-ifc** is a javascript library to read and write ifc files, at native speeds. **web-ifc** is part of the [That Open Company](https://thatopen.com) project, which aims to lower the threshold for developing open BIM applications.

## Install

`npm install web-ifc`

## Quick setup

```JavaScript
const WebIFC = require("web-ifc/web-ifc-api.js");

// initialize the API
const ifcApi = new WebIFC.IfcAPI();

// initialize the library
await ifcApi.Init();

// open a model from data
let modelID = ifcApi.OpenModel(/* IFC data as a string or UInt8Array */, /* optional settings object */, );

// the model is now loaded! use modelID to fetch geometry or properties
// checkout examples/usage for some details on how to read/write IFC

// close the model, all memory is freed
ifcApi.CloseModel(modelID);

```

See [examples](https://github.com/ThatOpen/engine_web-ifc/tree/main/examples/usage) for more details on how to use web-ifc.

## Current Build

The current live build of web-ifc is available [here](https://thatopen.github.io/engine_web-ifc/build.zip). Using this allows you to test newest fixes before we make a release. If you wish to use this version then download the zip file and place the contents of the dist folder manually into your node_modules/web-ifc folder. I.e if you are using web-ifc-three then it will be node_modules/web-ifc-three/node_modules/web-ifc. Please note you must replace the javascript and the WASM.

## Requirements

These are the requirements needed to build web-ifc (only for those that wish to build their own version).

1. Node v16 or later
2. NPM v7 or later
3. EMSCRIPTEN v4.0.23 or later
4. CMAKE v3.18 or later

## Regression Testing

We have a library of test models in the tests/public folder. If you have a model you would like to contribute please open a PR.

You can run regression tests on all these models by running `npm run regression`. It will alert you if any of the sample model geometry has changed. If the change is correct you can refresh the regression tests by running `npm run regression-update`.

## Building WASM module

### Setting up emscripten and build system

The WASM library is built through emscripten, please see [the emscripten installation guide](https://emscripten.org/docs/getting_started/downloads.html) for information on how to set up emscripten. Afterwards `emsdk_env` needs to be in your path.

To build the WASM you also need CMAKE [see here](https://cmake.org/download/) and (on windows) MINGW [see here](https://sourceforge.net/projects/mingw/) - once installed (and in your path) run `npm run setup-mingw` to configure the environment for web-ifc.

### WASM library

Run `npm install` to install all dependencies.

Run `npm run setup-env` whenever you open a new terminal, this will set up the required emscripten environment variables for you to compile code.

Run `npm run build-release` to build a release version of the wasm binary and the accompanying web-ifc api. It will be placed in `./dist`.

If you wish to build the WASM with debugging enabled you can run `npm run build-debug`. This will enable you to inspect debugging information better when running web-ifc.

Run `npm run dev` to launch a development server with a basic ifc file viewer.

### Build Files

The output of the build process consts of the following files:

1. web-ifc.wasm - The wasm (compiled C++) to run in the browser
2. web-ifc-mt.wasm - The wasm (compiled C++) to run in the browser if multi-threading is supported.
3. web-ifc-node.wasm - The wasm (compiled C++) to run in node
4. web-ifc-api-node.js - Compiled javascript wrapper for the wasm to run in node.
5. web-ifc-api-node.d.ts - Typescript definitions for the web-ifc api (for node)
6. web-ifc-api.js - Compiled javascript wrapper for the wasm to run in browser.
7. web-ifc-api.d.ts - Typescript definitions for the main web-ifc API
8. ifc-schema.d.ts - Typescript definitions for the IFC schema
9. helpers/properties.d.ts - Typescript definitions for the properties aspect of the web-ifc API
10. helpers/log.d.ts - Typescript definitions for the logger aspect of the web-ifc API
11. web-ifc-mt.worker.js - Webworker javascript to enable multi-threading in the browser.

## Stand alone C++

Although the primary focus of the library is to be used through WebAssembly in the browser/nodejs, the project can be used stand-alone as a c++ library or executable. See [here](https://github.com/ThatOpen/engine_web-ifc/blob/main/src/cpp/test/web-ifc-test.cpp) for a simple entry point to get started.

[npm]: https://img.shields.io/npm/v/web-ifc
[npm-url]: https://www.npmjs.com/package/web-ifc
[npm-downloads]: https://img.shields.io/npm/dw/web-ifc

--- FILE: public/web-ifc/revit-parametric-engine.d.ts ---
```ts
﻿export type ParamKindName =
  | 'Length' | 'Area' | 'Volume' | 'Angle'
  | 'Number' | 'Integer' | 'Text' | 'YesNo'
  | 'Material' | 'URL' | 'FamilyType';

export interface ParameterSpec {
  name: string;
  kind?: ParamKindName;
  isType?: boolean;
  isInstance?: boolean;
  group?: string;
  formula?: string;
  unit?: string;
  default?: number | string;
  isReadOnly?: boolean;
  isShared?: boolean;
}

export interface GeometryRecipe { kind: string; [k: string]: unknown; }

export interface FamilySpec {
  category?: string;
  parameters?: ParameterSpec[];
  formulas?: string[];
  constraints?: Constraint[];
  geometry?: (params: Record<string, number | string>) => GeometryRecipe;
}

export class Constraint {
  constructor(kind: 'equal'|'ratio'|'lock'|'sum'|'range', target: string[], params?: any);
  satisfied(ctx: Record<string, number>): boolean;
  resolve(ctx: Record<string, number>, mutable: Set<string>): boolean;
}

export class RevitParametricEngine {
  static attach(api: any, modelID: number, options?: any): RevitParametricEngine;
  units: any;
  families: Map<string, any>;
  instances: Map<number, any>;
  loadFamilies(): Map<string, any>;
  defineFamily(name: string, spec: FamilySpec): any;
  defineType(familyName: string, typeName: string, overrides?: Record<string, any>): any;
  bindInstance(expressID: number, familyName: string, typeName: string): any;
  effectiveParameters(expressID: number): Record<string, number | string> | null;
  setTypeParameter(familyName: string, typeName: string, paramName: string, value: any): any;
  setInstanceParameter(expressID: number, paramName: string, value: any): any;
  addConstraint(familyName: string, c: Constraint): any;
  regenerate(opts?: { dryRun?: boolean }): any[];
  beginTransaction(label?: string): { commit(): void; rollback(): void };
  commit(): void;
  rollback(): void;
  listFamilies(): Array<{ name: string; category: string; typeCount: number; parameters: string[] }>;
  listTypes(familyName: string): string[];
  listInstances(familyName: string, typeName: string): number[];
}

export const FormulaEngine: {
  compile(src: string): unknown;
  evaluate(src: string, ctx: Record<string, number | string>): number | string;
};
export const GeometryBuilder: { build(recipe: GeometryRecipe | ((p: any) => GeometryRecipe), params: Record<string, any>): any; };
export const UnitSystem: { new (): any; detectFromIfc(api: any, modelID: number): any; };

```

--- FILE: public/web-ifc/revit-parametric-engine.js ---
```js
﻿/* ============================================================================
 * revit-parametric-engine.js
 * Revit-style parametric engine for web-ifc.
 * UMD. Attaches to window.WebIFCWasm when loaded in a browser.
 * ========================================================================== */
(function (root, factory) {
  if (typeof module === 'object' && module.exports) module.exports = factory();
  else root.RevitParametricEngine = factory();
})(typeof globalThis !== 'undefined' ? globalThis : this, function () {
  'use strict';

  /* -------- units -------- */
  var UnitScale = {
    Length: { MILLIMETRE:1e-3, MILLIMETER:1e-3, CENTIMETRE:1e-2, CENTIMETER:1e-2,
              METRE:1, METER:1, FOOT:0.3048, INCH:0.0254 },
    Angle:  { RADIAN:1, DEGREE:Math.PI/180 },
    Area:   { SQUARE_METRE:1, SQUARE_METER:1, SQUARE_MILLIMETRE:1e-6, SQUARE_FOOT:0.09290304 },
    Volume: { CUBIC_METRE:1, CUBIC_METER:1, LITRE:1e-3, LITER:1e-3 }
  };
  function UnitSystem(){ this.length='METRE'; this.angle='RADIAN'; this.area='SQUARE_METRE'; this.volume='CUBIC_METRE'; }
  UnitSystem.prototype.toSI   = function(k,v,u){ var f=(UnitScale[k]||{})[String(u||'').toUpperCase()]; return f===undefined?v:v*f; };
  UnitSystem.prototype.fromSI = function(k,v,u){ var f=(UnitScale[k]||{})[String(u||'').toUpperCase()]; return f===undefined?v:v/f; };
  UnitSystem.detectFromIfc = function(api, modelID){
    var u = new UnitSystem();
    try {
      var ids = api.GetLineIDsWithType(modelID, 180925521);
      if (!ids || ids.size() === 0) return u;
      var ua = api.GetLine(modelID, ids.get(0));
      (ua.Units || []).forEach(function(h){
        var un = api.GetLine(modelID, h.value);
        if (!un || !un.Name) return;
        var n = un.Name.value;
        if (n === 'METRE') u.length = 'METRE';
        else if (n === 'MILLIMETRE') u.length = 'MILLIMETRE';
        else if (n === 'FOOT') u.length = 'FOOT';
      });
    } catch(e){}
    return u;
  };

  /* -------- parameter kinds -------- */
  var ParamKind = Object.freeze({
    Length:'Length', Area:'Area', Volume:'Volume', Angle:'Angle',
    Number:'Number', Integer:'Integer', Text:'Text', YesNo:'YesNo',
    Material:'Material', URL:'URL', FamilyType:'FamilyType'
  });

  function Parameter(spec){
    this.name = spec.name;
    this.kind = spec.kind || ParamKind.Number;
    this.isType = !!spec.isType;
    this.isInstance = spec.isInstance !== undefined ? !!spec.isInstance : !this.isType;
    this.group = spec.group || 'Other';
    this.formula = spec.formula || null;
    this.unit = spec.unit || null;
    this.isReadOnly = !!spec.isReadOnly || !!this.formula;
    this.isShared = !!spec.isShared;
    this.value = spec.default !== undefined ? spec.default : this._default();
  }
  Parameter.prototype._default = function(){
    switch (this.kind) {
      case ParamKind.Number: case ParamKind.Length: case ParamKind.Area:
      case ParamKind.Volume: case ParamKind.Angle: case ParamKind.Integer:
      case ParamKind.YesNo: return 0;
      default: return '';
    }
  };
  Parameter.prototype.coerce = function(v){
    switch (this.kind) {
      case ParamKind.Number: case ParamKind.Length:
      case ParamKind.Area:   case ParamKind.Volume:
      case ParamKind.Angle:  return Number(v) || 0;
      case ParamKind.Integer: return Math.round(Number(v)) || 0;
      case ParamKind.YesNo:   return v ? 1 : 0;
      default: return v == null ? '' : String(v);
    }
  };

  /* -------- formula engine (safe) -------- */
  var FormulaEngine = (function(){
    var FN = {
      sin:Math.sin, cos:Math.cos, tan:Math.tan,
      asin:Math.asin, acos:Math.acos, atan:Math.atan,
